        Case "+N": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Tension|Compression"
        Case "+Mx": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "+Y tension|-Y tension"
        Case "+My": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "+X tension|-X tension"
        Case "MaterialModel.Stability.ValueSet", "MaterialModel.Strength.ValueSet", "MaterialModel.CrackInitiation.ValueSet", "MaterialModel.CrackedState.ValueSet"
            ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "ULS(I)|SLS(II)"
        Case "MaterialModel.Strength.ConcreteDiagram", "MaterialModel.CrackInitiation.ConcreteDiagram", "MaterialModel.CrackedState.ConcreteDiagram", _
                "MaterialModel.Strength.SteelDiagram", "MaterialModel.CrackInitiation.SteelDiagram", "MaterialModel.CrackedState.SteelDiagram"
            ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "TwoLine|ThreeLine"
        Case "MaterialModel.Strength.ConcreteTension": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Ignore|UseDiagram"
        Case "Visualization.State": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "StrengthState|CapacityState|PreCrackState|PostCrackState|CrackedState"
        Case "Visualization.Quantity": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Stress|Strain"
        Case "Placement": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Outside|Inside"
        Case "TextUnits": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "mm|pt"
        Case "ArrowType": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Triangle|Stealth|Diamond|Oval|Open"
        Case "ArrowSize": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Small|Medium|Wide"
        Case "Rebar.Loc2row", "Rebar.Loc3row": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Stacked|SideBySide"
        Case "Rebar.Bind2row", "Rebar.Bind3row": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "EachBar|EverySecondBar"
        Case "RectSet.SectionType": ExpectedConfigDropdownOptions = "Rectangle|LSection|TwoRectangles"
    End Select

' Проверяет все list-ячейки Config и по одному представителю каждого
' источника. Ссылочные списки не зависят от локального разделителя Excel;
' проверка Validation.Value выявляет ситуацию, когда вся строка стала пунктом.
Private Sub TestConfigDropdownChoices(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats)
    Dim sheet As Object, cells As Object, cell As Object, source As Object, optionCell As Object
    Dim checked As Object, formula As String, prefix As String, saved As Variant
    Dim sample As Object, options As Long, lists As Long, targets As Long
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.item("Config")
    Set cells = sheet.cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeAllValidation)
    Set checked = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each cell In cells.cells
        If cell.MergeCells Then
            If cell.address <> cell.MergeArea.cells(1, 1).address Then GoTo NextCell
        End If
        If cell.validation.Type = xlValidateList Then
            targets = targets + 1
            formula = CStr(cell.validation.Formula1)
            prefix = "config.dropdown." & cell.address(False, False)
            AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rangeSource", left$(formula, 1) = "="
            AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".visible", cell.validation.InCellDropdown
            If left$(formula, 1) = "=" And Not checked.Exists(formula) Then
                checked.Add formula, True
                Set source = sheet.range(mid$(formula, 2))
                AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".vertical", source.columns.count = 1
                Set sample = cell
                saved = sample.formula
                options = 0
                For Each optionCell In source.cells
                    If Not IsError(optionCell.value2) Then
                        If Len(CStr(optionCell.value2)) > 0 Then
                            options = options + 1
                            sample.value2 = optionCell.value2
                            AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".accepts." & CStr(options), sample.validation.value
                        End If
                    Else
                        AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".sourceError", False
                    End If
                Next optionCell
                sample.value2 = "__INVALID_DROPDOWN_OPTION__"
                AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".rejectsUnknown", Not sample.validation.value
                sample.formula = saved
                Set sample = Nothing
                AssertTrue stats, prefix & ".notEmpty", options > 0
                lists = lists + 1
            End If
        End If
NextCell:
    Next cell
    AssertTrue stats, "config.dropdown.targetsPresent", targets > 0
    AppendLine stats, "CONFIG_DROPDOWNS: targets=" & CStr(targets) & "; rangeSources=" & CStr(lists)
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    Dim Code As Long, reason As String
    Code = Err.number: reason = Err.description
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not sample Is Nothing Then sample.formula = saved
    On Error GoTo 0
    AssertTrue stats, "config.dropdown.runtime." & CStr(Code) & "." & reason, False
End Sub

' Проверяет правую грань каждой строки общей таблицы, включая последнюю
' колонку Справка. Адреса берутся из имени, а не из фиксированных букв/строк.
Private Sub TestConfigSettingsRightBorder(ByRef stats As TUiTestStats)
    Dim settings As Object, cell As Object, row As Long
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set settings = ThisWorkbook.names.item("rngSystemSettings").RefersToRange
    For row = 1 To settings.rows.count
        Set cell = settings.cells(row, settings.columns.count)
        If cell.MergeCells Then Set cell = cell.MergeArea
        AssertTrue stats, "config.settings.rightBorder." & CStr(row), _
            cell.Borders(xlEdgeRight).LineStyle = xlDash And _
            cell.Borders(xlEdgeRight).weight = xlThin And _
            cell.Borders(xlEdgeRight).Color = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    Next row
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    AssertTrue stats, "config.settings.rightBorder.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' Непрерывная линия из отрезков и дуг
' ==========================================================================
' Описывает открытый или замкнутый контур для границы бетона, расстановки
' арматуры и привязки аннотаций. После Seal геометрия не изменяется.
' Длины и параметры подготавливаются один раз; формулы отдельных сегментов
' находятся в modGeometryPrimitives.

Private Const PATH_TOLERANCE As Double = 0.000001 ' Допуск стыков, мм.
Private mid As String ' Имя линии в описании сечения; используется для ссылок на неё из правил и аннотаций.
Private mEdges() As TRegionEdge ' Отрезки и дуги в порядке обхода линии; соединения между раздельными участками не добавляются.
Private mSegmentIDs() As String ' Имена отрезков и дуг этой линии для привязки правил и аннотаций.
Private mSourcePathIDs() As String, mSourceSegmentIDs() As String ' Имена исходных линий и сегментов для каждого полученного сегмента.
Private mSourceStart() As Double, mSourceEnd() As Double ' Начальный и конечный параметры исходного сегмента для переноса привязанных точек.
Private mStations() As Double ' Накопленные длины сегментов; позволяют искать точку без повторного суммирования.
Private mCollapsedIDs() As String, mCollapsedStations() As Double, mCollapsedCount As Long ' Имена исчезнувших при построении участков и координаты их привязки; новые отрезки вместо них не создаются.
Private mCount As Long, mCapacity As Long ' Число аналитических сегментов и ёмкость рабочего массива.
Private mSealed As Boolean, mClosed As Boolean ' Завершение построения и фактическая замкнутость линии.
Private mDiagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic ' Последняя ошибка построения или обращения к линии.

' Последняя машинная диагностика; Nothing при отсутствии записанного события.
Public Property Get LastDiagnostic() As CGeometryDiagnostic
    Set LastDiagnostic = mDiagnostic
End Property

' Начинает описание линии с непустым ID. Допускается только один вызов для объекта.
Public Sub Initialize(ByVal pathID As String)
    If Len(mid) > 0 Then PathError "Путь уже инициализирован."
    If Len(Trim$(pathID)) = 0 Then PathError "Не задан ID пути."
    mid = pathID
End Sub

' Добавляет отрезок с заданным ID; его начало должно совпадать с концом предыдущего сегмента.
Public Sub AddLine(ByVal segmentID As String, ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double, _
        ByVal x2 As Double, ByVal y2 As Double)
    Dim edge As TRegionEdge
    edge.x1 = x1: edge.y1 = y1: edge.x2 = x2: edge.y2 = y2
    Append segmentID, edge
End Sub

' Добавляет дугу по центру, радиусу, начальному углу и углу обхода со знаком, в радианах.
' Полный оборот допустим; нулевая дуга и дуга больше одного оборота вызывают ошибку.
Public Sub AddArc(ByVal segmentID As String, ByVal centerX As Double, ByVal centerY As Double, _
        ByVal Radius As Double, ByVal startAngle As Double, ByVal sweep As Double)
    RequireMutable
    If Radius <= 0# Then PathError "Радиус дуги должен быть положительным.", "INVALID_RADIUS", segmentID, Radius
    If Abs(sweep) <= 0.0000000001 Or Abs(sweep) > 2# * GEOM_PI Then PathError "Угол дуги должен быть ненулевым и не больше полного оборота.", "INVALID_SWEEP", segmentID, sweep
    Dim edge As TRegionEdge
    edge.centerX = centerX: edge.centerY = centerY: edge.sweep = sweep
    edge.x1 = centerX + Radius * Cos(startAngle): edge.y1 = centerY + Radius * Sin(startAngle)
    edge.x2 = centerX + Radius * Cos(startAngle + sweep): edge.y2 = centerY + Radius * Sin(startAngle + sweep)
    If Abs(sweep) = 2# * GEOM_PI Then edge.x2 = edge.x1: edge.y2 = edge.y1
    Append segmentID, edge
End Sub

' Завершает и проверяет линию, после чего менять её нельзя.
' Разрывы не соединяются дополнительными отрезками. Запрос Closed
' не замыкает разные концы автоматически: они уже должны совпадать.
Public Sub Seal(Optional ByVal Closed As Boolean = False)
    RequireMutable
    If mCount = 0 Then PathError "Путь не содержит сегментов."
    If Closed Then
        If Not PointsCoincide(mEdges(1).x1, mEdges(1).y1, mEdges(mCount).x2, mEdges(mCount).y2) Then _
            PathError "Замкнутый путь имеет разные начало и конец."
    End If
    ReDim Preserve mEdges(1 To mCount)
    ReDim Preserve mSegmentIDs(1 To mCount)
    ReDim Preserve mSourcePathIDs(1 To mCount): ReDim Preserve mSourceSegmentIDs(1 To mCount)
    ReDim Preserve mSourceStart(1 To mCount): ReDim Preserve mSourceEnd(1 To mCount)
    ReDim Preserve mStations(0 To mCount)
    mCapacity = mCount: mClosed = Closed: mSealed = True
End Sub

' Возвращает имя линии, по которому на неё ссылаются правила и аннотации.
Public Property Get id() As String: id = mid: End Property
' Возвращает число отрезков и дуг линии.
Public Property Get segmentCount() As Long: segmentCount = mCount: End Property
' Показывает, завершено ли описание линии и запрещены ли дальнейшие изменения.
Public Property Get IsSealed() As Boolean: IsSealed = mSealed: End Property
' Замкнут ли фактический путь, без фиктивного соединения.
Public Property Get IsClosed() As Boolean: RequireSealed: IsClosed = mClosed: End Property
' Точная суммарная длина пути, мм.
Public Property Get Length() As Double: RequireSealed: Length = mStations(mCount): End Property
' Возвращает имя отрезка или дуги по порядковому номеру в линии.
Public Property Get segmentID(ByVal index As Long) As String
    CheckIndex index: segmentID = mSegmentIDs(index)
End Property

' Возвращает ID линии, из которой получен сегмент после обрезки, преобразования или смещения.
Public Property Get sourcePathID(ByVal index As Long) As String
    CheckIndex index: sourcePathID = mSourcePathIDs(index)
End Property

' Возвращает исходное имя сегмента, сохранённое при его разделении или переименовании.
Public Property Get sourceSegmentID(ByVal index As Long) As String
    CheckIndex index: sourceSegmentID = mSourceSegmentIDs(index)
End Property

' Начальный параметр исходного сегмента; может выйти за [0;1] при явном продлении прямой.
Public Property Get SourceStartParameter(ByVal index As Long) As Double
    CheckIndex index: SourceStartParameter = mSourceStart(index)
End Property

' Конечный параметр исходного сегмента, включая обращённый обход.
Public Property Get SourceEndParameter(ByVal index As Long) As Double
    CheckIndex index: SourceEndParameter = mSourceEnd(index)
End Property

' Находит номер сегмента по его ID. Если нужная дуга исчезла при построении,
' сообщает об ошибке MISSING_SEGMENT.
Public Function segmentIndex(ByVal segmentID As String) As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To mCount
        If StrComp(mSegmentIDs(i), segmentID, vbBinaryCompare) = 0 Then segmentIndex = i: Exit Function
    Next i
    PathError "Не найден сегмент '" & segmentID & "'.", "MISSING_SEGMENT", segmentID
End Function

' Находит привязку по имени сегмента и доле его длины. Если сегмент исчез
' при построении, обе его границы соответствуют одному сохранённому стыку.
' Неизвестное имя вызывает ошибку.
Public Function AnchorStation(ByVal segmentID As String, Optional ByVal parameter As Double = 0#) As Double
    RequireSealed
    If parameter < 0# Or parameter > 1# Then PathError "Параметр привязки должен быть от 0 до 1."
    Dim index As Long
    For index = 1 To mCollapsedCount
        If mCollapsedIDs(index) = segmentID Then AnchorStation = mCollapsedStations(index): Exit Function
    Next index
    index = segmentIndex(segmentID)
    AnchorStation = mStations(index - 1) + parameter * (mStations(index) - mStations(index - 1))
End Function

' Находит существующий сегмент по точке на линии; параметр — доля его длины.
' Стык нескольких сегментов неоднозначен: для него задайте ID явно или выберите точку внутри участка.
Public Sub ResolveAnchor(ByVal x As Double, ByVal y As Double, _
        ByRef segmentID As String, ByRef parameter As Double)
    RequireSealed
    Dim i As Long, matched As Long, found As Long, candidate As Double, resolved As Double, matches As String
    For i = 1 To mCount
        If modGeometryPrimitives.PointParameter(mEdges(i), x, y, candidate) Then
            If matched > 0 Then matches = matches & ", "
            matches = matches & "'" & mSegmentIDs(i) & "'"
            matched = matched + 1: found = i: resolved = candidate
        End If
    Next i
    If matched = 0 Then PathError "Точка (" & CStr(x) & "; " & CStr(y) & ") не лежит на линии.", _
        "ANCHOR_NOT_ON_PATH", "", x, y
    If matched > 1 Then PathError "Точка (" & CStr(x) & "; " & CStr(y) & ") принадлежит нескольким сегментам: " & matches & _
        ". Задайте ID нужного сегмента явно или выберите точку внутри него.", "ANCHOR_AMBIGUOUS", matches, x, y
    ' Выходные аргументы меняются только после успешного однозначного поиска.
    segmentID = mSegmentIDs(found): parameter = resolved
End Sub

' Создаёт копию завершённой линии с новым ID, сохраняя имена сегментов
' и сведения о том, откуда они получены.
Public Function WithID(ByVal pathID As String) As CGeometryPath
    RequireSealed
    Dim result As CGeometryPath, i As Long
    Set result = New CGeometryPath: result.Initialize pathID
    For i = 1 To mCount
        result.Append mSegmentIDs(i), mEdges(i), mSourcePathIDs(i), mSourceSegmentIDs(i), mSourceStart(i), mSourceEnd(i)
    Next i
    CopyCollapsedAnchors result, 0#, Length, 0#
    result.Seal mClosed: Set WithID = result
End Function

' На замкнутом контуре направление обхода задается явно. Обход через начало
' не добавляет хорду; части сегмента сохраняют исходные ID и интервалы.
Public Function BetweenAnchors(ByVal pathID As String, ByVal startSegmentID As String, ByVal startParameter As Double, _
        ByVal endSegmentID As String, ByVal endParameter As Double, Optional ByVal forward As Boolean = True, _
        Optional ByVal fullLoopIfSame As Boolean = False) As CGeometryPath
    RequireSealed
    Dim result As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath, first As Double, last As Double
    If Not forward Then
        Set part = BetweenAnchors(pathID, endSegmentID, endParameter, startSegmentID, startParameter, True, fullLoopIfSame)
        Set BetweenAnchors = part.reversed: Exit Function
    End If
    first = AnchorStation(startSegmentID, startParameter): last = AnchorStation(endSegmentID, endParameter)
    If mClosed Then
        If first >= mStations(mCount) - PATH_TOLERANCE Then first = 0#
        If last >= mStations(mCount) - PATH_TOLERANCE Then last = 0#
    End If
    If last > first + PATH_TOLERANCE Then
        Set part = Slice(first, last): Set BetweenAnchors = part.WithID(pathID): Exit Function
    End If
    If Not mClosed Then PathError "Привязки открытого пути не соответствуют выбранному направлению."
    If Abs(first - last) <= PATH_TOLERANCE And Not fullLoopIfSame Then PathError "Привязки совпадают; полный обход должен быть задан явно."
    Set result = New CGeometryPath: result.Initialize pathID
    AppendInterval result, first, mStations(mCount)
    AppendInterval result, 0#, last
    result.Seal (Abs(first - last) <= PATH_TOLERANCE)
    Set BetweenAnchors = result
End Function

' Находит точку по пройденному расстоянию от начала линии, мм, и направление
' касательной в ней. На стыке по умолчанию берёт следующий сегмент;
' incomingTangentAtJoint выбирает направление предыдущего.
Public Sub AtDistance(ByVal distance As Double, ByRef x As Double, ByRef y As Double, _
        ByRef tangentX As Double, ByRef tangentY As Double, Optional ByVal IncomingTangentAtJoint As Boolean = False)
    RequireSealed
    distance = CheckedDistance(distance)
    Dim lo As Long, hi As Long, middle As Long, parameter As Double, norm As Double
    lo = 1: hi = mCount
    Do While lo < hi
        middle = lo + (hi - lo) \ 2
        If distance < mStations(middle) Or (IncomingTangentAtJoint And distance <= mStations(middle) + GEOM_TOLERANCE) Then
            hi = middle
        Else
            lo = middle + 1
        End If
    Loop
    parameter = (distance - mStations(lo - 1)) / (mStations(lo) - mStations(lo - 1))
    parameter = GeomMax(0#, GeomMin(1#, parameter))
    modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint mEdges(lo), parameter, x, y
    modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeTangent mEdges(lo), parameter, tangentX, tangentY
    norm = Sqr(tangentX * tangentX + tangentY * tangentY)
    tangentX = tangentX / norm: tangentY = tangentY / norm
End Sub

' Возвращает наименьшую и наибольшую проекции линии на заданное направление.
' Учитывает крайние точки дуг, которые могут лежать между их концами.
Public Sub ProjectionBounds(ByVal directionX As Double, ByVal directionY As Double, _
        ByRef minimum As Double, ByRef maximum As Double)
    RequireSealed
    Dim norm As Double, i As Long
    norm = Sqr(directionX * directionX + directionY * directionY)
    If norm <= GEOM_TOLERANCE Then PathError "Направление проекции имеет нулевую длину."
    directionX = directionX / norm: directionY = directionY / norm
    minimum = 1E+100: maximum = -1E+100
    For i = 1 To mCount
        modGeometryPrimitives.AccumulateEdgeProjection mEdges(i), directionX, directionY, minimum, maximum
    Next i
End Sub

' Вырезает участок составной линии по расстояниям от её начала.
' Отсчёт длины на стыках не начинается заново; точные дуги и имена сегментов сохраняются.
Public Function Slice(ByVal startDistance As Double, ByVal endDistance As Double) As CGeometryPath
    RequireSealed
    startDistance = CheckedDistance(startDistance): endDistance = CheckedDistance(endDistance)
    If endDistance <= startDistance + PATH_TOLERANCE Then PathError "Рабочая длина пути после отсечения неположительна."
    Dim result As CGeometryPath, i As Long, first As Double, last As Double, segmentLength As Double, edge As TRegionEdge
    Set result = New CGeometryPath: result.Initialize mid
    For i = 1 To mCount
        first = GeomMax(startDistance, mStations(i - 1)): last = GeomMin(endDistance, mStations(i))
        If last > first + PATH_TOLERANCE Then
            segmentLength = mStations(i) - mStations(i - 1)
            modGeometryPrimitives.SubEdge mEdges(i), (first - mStations(i - 1)) / segmentLength, (last - mStations(i - 1)) / segmentLength, edge
            result.Append mSegmentIDs(i), edge, mSourcePathIDs(i), mSourceSegmentIDs(i), _
                OriginParameter(i, (first - mStations(i - 1)) / segmentLength), OriginParameter(i, (last - mStations(i - 1)) / segmentLength)
        End If
    Next i
    CopyCollapsedAnchors result, startDistance, endDistance, 0#
    result.Seal (mClosed And startDistance = 0# And endDistance = mStations(mCount))
    Set Slice = result
End Function

' Добавляет части линии между заданными расстояниями от её начала,
' сохраняя отрезки и дуги без замены приближённой ломаной.
Private Sub AppendInterval(ByVal result As CGeometryPath, ByVal first As Double, ByVal last As Double)
    If last <= first + PATH_TOLERANCE Then Exit Sub
    Dim part As CGeometryPath, i As Long, edge As TRegionEdge, Name As String, suffix As Long, offset As Double
    offset = result.AccumulatedLength
    Set part = Slice(first, last)
    For i = 1 To part.segmentCount
        part.CopySegment i, edge: Name = part.segmentID(i): suffix = 1
        Do While result.HasSegmentID(Name)
            suffix = suffix + 1: Name = part.segmentID(i) & ".Part" & CStr(suffix)
        Loop
        result.Append Name, edge, part.sourcePathID(i), part.sourceSegmentID(i), part.SourceStartParameter(i), part.SourceEndParameter(i)
    Next i
    part.CopyCollapsedAnchors result, 0#, part.Length, offset
End Sub

' Сохраняет место исчезнувшего участка как именованную точку привязки.
' Сам участок не добавляется. Вызывать можно, когда построитель знает точное место его
' исчезновения.
Friend Sub AddCollapsedSegment(ByVal segmentID As String, Optional ByVal station As Double = -1#)
    RequireMutable
    If Len(Trim$(segmentID)) = 0 Then PathError "Не задан ID исчезнувшего сегмента."
    If HasSegmentID(segmentID) Then PathError "Повторный ID сегмента '" & segmentID & "'."
    Dim i As Long, currentLength As Double
    For i = 1 To mCollapsedCount
        If mCollapsedIDs(i) = segmentID Then PathError "Повторный ID привязки '" & segmentID & "'."
    Next i
    If mCount > 0 Then currentLength = mStations(mCount)
    If station = -1# Then station = currentLength
    If station < -PATH_TOLERANCE Or station > currentLength + PATH_TOLERANCE Then PathError "Привязка исчезнувшего сегмента вне пути."
    station = GeomMax(0#, GeomMin(currentLength, station))
    mCollapsedCount = mCollapsedCount + 1
    ReDim Preserve mCollapsedIDs(1 To mCollapsedCount): ReDim Preserve mCollapsedStations(1 To mCollapsedCount)
    mCollapsedIDs(mCollapsedCount) = segmentID: mCollapsedStations(mCollapsedCount) = station
End Sub

' Переносит только привязки внутри выбранного интервала. При обратном обходе
' отсчёт меняется вместе с геометрией; на замыкающем стыке достаточно одного имени.
Friend Sub CopyCollapsedAnchors(ByVal result As CGeometryPath, ByVal first As Double, ByVal last As Double, _
        ByVal offset As Double, Optional ByVal reverse As Boolean = False)
    Dim i As Long, station As Double
    For i = 1 To mCollapsedCount
        station = mCollapsedStations(i)
        If station >= first And station <= last Then
            If Not result.HasCollapsedSegmentID(mCollapsedIDs(i)) Then
                If reverse Then station = last - station Else station = station - first
                result.AddCollapsedSegment mCollapsedIDs(i), offset + station
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

' Возвращает длину уже добавленных сегментов, чтобы продолжить сборку линии до Seal.
Friend Property Get AccumulatedLength() As Double
    If mCount > 0 Then AccumulatedLength = mStations(mCount)
End Property

' Проверяет, сохранено ли имя как точка привязки исчезнувшего участка.
' Такая привязка отличается от существующего сегмента и от неизвестного имени.
Friend Function HasCollapsedSegmentID(ByVal segmentID As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To mCollapsedCount
        If mCollapsedIDs(i) = segmentID Then HasCollapsedSegmentID = True: Exit Function
    Next i
End Function

' Переводит локальный параметр обрезанного сегмента в параметр исходного сегмента.
Private Function OriginParameter(ByVal index As Long, ByVal parameter As Double) As Double
    OriginParameter = mSourceStart(index) + parameter * (mSourceEnd(index) - mSourceStart(index))
End Function

' Проверяет, остался ли сегмент с указанным именем в линии.
' Отрезок, исчезнувший при скруглении, существующим сегментом не считается.
Friend Function HasSegmentID(ByVal segmentID As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To mCount
        If StrComp(mSegmentIDs(i), segmentID, vbBinaryCompare) = 0 Then HasSegmentID = True: Exit Function
    Next i
End Function

' Создаёт копию линии с обратным направлением обхода и порядком сегментов.
' Меняет знаки углов дуг и направление отсчёта параметров исходных сегментов.
Public Function reversed() As CGeometryPath
    RequireSealed
    Dim result As CGeometryPath, i As Long, edge As TRegionEdge
    Set result = New CGeometryPath: result.Initialize mid
    For i = mCount To 1 Step -1
        LSet edge = mEdges(i): modGeometryPrimitives.ReverseEdge edge
        result.Append mSegmentIDs(i), edge, mSourcePathIDs(i), mSourceSegmentIDs(i), mSourceEnd(i), mSourceStart(i)
    Next i
    CopyCollapsedAnchors result, 0#, Length, 0#, True
    result.Seal mClosed
    Set reversed = result
End Function

' Создаёт преобразованную линию: отражает относительно локальной оси X,
' поворачивает вокруг (0, 0), затем переносит. При отражении меняет знак
' угла обхода дуг; имена сегментов сохраняет.
Public Function transformed(ByVal shiftX As Double, ByVal shiftY As Double, _
        Optional ByVal rotation As Double = 0#, Optional ByVal reflectX As Boolean = False) As CGeometryPath
    RequireSealed
    Dim result As CGeometryPath, i As Long, edge As TRegionEdge, cosine As Double, sine As Double
    Set result = New CGeometryPath: result.Initialize mid
    cosine = Cos(rotation): sine = Sin(rotation)
    For i = 1 To mCount
        LSet edge = mEdges(i)
        TransformPoint edge.x1, edge.y1, shiftX, shiftY, cosine, sine, reflectX
        TransformPoint edge.x2, edge.y2, shiftX, shiftY, cosine, sine, reflectX
        If edge.sweep <> 0# Then
            TransformPoint edge.centerX, edge.centerY, shiftX, shiftY, cosine, sine, reflectX
            If reflectX Then edge.sweep = -edge.sweep
        End If
        result.Append mSegmentIDs(i), edge, mSourcePathIDs(i), mSourceSegmentIDs(i), mSourceStart(i), mSourceEnd(i)
    Next i
    CopyCollapsedAnchors result, 0#, Length, 0#
    result.Seal mClosed
    Set transformed = result
End Function

' Ищет ближайшее пересечение в положительном направлении проекции
' с фактическими отрезками и дугами целевой линии. Без пересечения возвращает False;
' продолжения линий до бесконечности не используются.
Public Function RayHit(ByVal originX As Double, ByVal originY As Double, ByVal directionX As Double, _
        ByVal directionY As Double, ByRef pathDistance As Double, ByRef rayDistance As Double) As Boolean
    RequireSealed
    Dim i As Long, distance As Double, parameter As Double
    pathDistance = 0#: rayDistance = 0#
    If Sqr(directionX * directionX + directionY * directionY) <= GEOM_TOLERANCE Then PathError "Направление луча имеет нулевую длину."
    For i = 1 To mCount
        If modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeRayHit(mEdges(i), originX, originY, directionX, directionY, distance, parameter) Then
            If Not RayHit Or distance < rayDistance Then
                rayDistance = distance
                pathDistance = mStations(i - 1) + parameter * (mStations(i) - mStations(i - 1))
                RayHit = True
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Function

' Копирует данные аналитического сегмента в переданную структуру без изменения пути.
Friend Sub CopySegment(ByVal index As Long, ByRef edge As TRegionEdge)
    RequireSealed
    CheckIndex index
    LSet edge = mEdges(index)
End Sub

' Присоединяет сегменты другого пути с проверкой геометрической непрерывности.
Friend Sub Append(ByVal segmentID As String, ByRef edge As TRegionEdge, Optional ByVal sourcePathID As String = "", _
        Optional ByVal sourceSegmentID As String = "", Optional ByVal sourceStart As Double = 0#, Optional ByVal sourceEnd As Double = 1#)
    RequireMutable
    If Len(Trim$(segmentID)) = 0 Then PathError "Не задан ID сегмента."
    Dim i As Long, segmentLength As Double
    For i = 1 To mCount
        If mSegmentIDs(i) = segmentID Then PathError "Повторный ID сегмента '" & segmentID & "'."
    Next i
    For i = 1 To mCollapsedCount
        If mCollapsedIDs(i) = segmentID Then PathError "Повторный ID привязки '" & segmentID & "'."
    Next i
    segmentLength = modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(edge)
    If segmentLength <= PATH_TOLERANCE Then PathError "Сегмент '" & segmentID & "' имеет нулевую длину."
    If mCount > 0 Then
        If Not PointsCoincide(mEdges(mCount).x2, mEdges(mCount).y2, edge.x1, edge.y1) Then _
            PathError "Разрыв перед сегментом '" & segmentID & "'. Несвязанные пути должны быть отдельными."
    End If
    If mCount = mCapacity Then
        mCapacity = GeomMax(4#, CDbl(mCapacity) * 2#)
        ReDim Preserve mEdges(1 To mCapacity)
        ReDim Preserve mSegmentIDs(1 To mCapacity)
        ReDim Preserve mSourcePathIDs(1 To mCapacity): ReDim Preserve mSourceSegmentIDs(1 To mCapacity)
        ReDim Preserve mSourceStart(1 To mCapacity): ReDim Preserve mSourceEnd(1 To mCapacity)
        ReDim Preserve mStations(0 To mCapacity)
    End If
    mCount = mCount + 1
    LSet mEdges(mCount) = edge: mSegmentIDs(mCount) = segmentID
    If Len(sourcePathID) = 0 Then sourcePathID = mid
    If Len(sourceSegmentID) = 0 Then sourceSegmentID = segmentID
    mSourcePathIDs(mCount) = sourcePathID: mSourceSegmentIDs(mCount) = sourceSegmentID
    mSourceStart(mCount) = sourceStart: mSourceEnd(mCount) = sourceEnd
    mStations(mCount) = mStations(mCount - 1) + segmentLength
End Sub

' Отражает, поворачивает и переносит точку; координаты остаются в мм.
Private Sub TransformPoint(ByRef x As Double, ByRef y As Double, ByVal shiftX As Double, ByVal shiftY As Double, _
        ByVal cosine As Double, ByVal sine As Double, ByVal reflectX As Boolean)
    Dim newX As Double
    If reflectX Then y = -y
    newX = cosine * x - sine * y + shiftX
    y = sine * x + cosine * y + shiftY: x = newX
End Sub

' Сравнивает координаты двух точек в геометрическом допуске.
Private Function PointsCoincide(ByVal x1 As Double, ByVal y1 As Double, ByVal x2 As Double, ByVal y2 As Double) As Boolean
    PointsCoincide = (Sqr((x2 - x1) ^ 2 + (y2 - y1) ^ 2) <= PATH_TOLERANCE)
End Function

' Проверяет расстояние от начала линии до точки. Исправляет только малую
' погрешность у концов; заведомо недопустимое расстояние вызывает ошибку.
Private Function CheckedDistance(ByVal distance As Double) As Double
    If distance < -PATH_TOLERANCE Or distance > mStations(mCount) + PATH_TOLERANCE Then PathError "Позиция выходит за пределы длины пути."
    CheckedDistance = GeomMax(0#, GeomMin(mStations(mCount), distance))
End Function

' Запрещает изменение линии после её завершения методом Seal.
Private Sub RequireMutable()
    If Len(mid) = 0 Then PathError "Путь не инициализирован."
    If mSealed Then PathError "Опубликованный путь нельзя изменять."
End Sub

' Требует завершённую проверенную геометрию перед её использованием.
Private Sub RequireSealed()
    If Not mSealed Then PathError "Путь еще не подготовлен и не опубликован."
End Sub

' Проверяет индекс перед обращением к массивам геометрического объекта.
Private Sub CheckIndex(ByVal index As Long)
    If index < 1 Or index > mCount Then PathError "Номер сегмента вне допустимого диапазона."
End Sub

' Выдаёт геометрическую ошибку с ID пути и фактической причиной.
Private Sub PathError(ByVal description As String, Optional ByVal Code As String = "PATH_INVALID", _
        Optional ByVal relatedEntityID As String = "", Optional ByVal detail1 As Double = 0#, Optional ByVal detail2 As Double = 0#)
    Set mDiagnostic = New CGeometryDiagnostic
    mDiagnostic.Initialize Code, mid, relatedEntityID, description, detail1, detail2
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 5520, "CGeometryPath", "Путь '" & mid & "': " & description
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: точные линии и дуги общего геометрического слоя без Excel и сетки.
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: единый короткий набор общего геометрического слоя.
Public Function RunCoreGeometryTests() As String
    Dim result As String
    result = RunPathTests()
    result = result & RunPathAnchorTests()
    result = result & RunRoundedPolygonTests()
    result = result & RunRoundedOffsetTests()
    result = result & RunInputTableTests()
    RunCoreGeometryTests = result
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: выделение именованных участков контура, переход через его начало
' и сохранение соответствия сегментов исходным линиям.
Public Function RunPathAnchorTests() As String
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath, changed As CGeometryPath, edge As TRegionEdge
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition
    Dim x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, scenario As Long
    Set path = CompoundPath
    Near "anchor.named.station", path.AnchorStation("Corner", 0.5), 100# + 12.5 * GEOM_PI
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Chain", "Bottom", 0.25, "Corner", 0.5)
    Check "anchor.chain.id", part.id = "Chain" And Not part.IsClosed
    Check "anchor.chain.count", part.segmentCount = 2
    Near "anchor.chain.length", part.Length, 75# + 12.5 * GEOM_PI
    Check "anchor.chain.source.path", part.sourcePathID(1) = "Outer.Mixed" And part.sourcePathID(2) = "Outer.Mixed"
    Check "anchor.chain.source.segment", part.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Bottom" And part.sourceSegmentID(2) = "Corner"
    Near "anchor.chain.source.first", part.SourceStartParameter(1), 0.25
    Near "anchor.chain.source.last", part.SourceEndParameter(2), 0.5
    Set part = path.Slice(20#, 80#): Set changed = part.reversed
    Near "anchor.reverse.source.first", changed.SourceStartParameter(1), 0.8
    Near "anchor.reverse.source.last", changed.SourceEndParameter(1), 0.2
    Set part = changed.Slice(10#, 50#)
    Near "anchor.nested.source.first", part.SourceStartParameter(1), 0.7
    Near "anchor.nested.source.last", part.SourceEndParameter(1), 0.3
    Set changed = part.transformed(1000#, -2000#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True): Set part = changed.WithID("Moved")
    Check "anchor.transform.id", part.id = "Moved" And part.segmentID(1) = "Bottom"
    Check "anchor.transform.source", part.sourcePathID(1) = "Outer.Mixed" And part.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Bottom"
    Near "anchor.transform.source.first", part.SourceStartParameter(1), 0.7
    Near "anchor.transform.source.last", part.SourceEndParameter(1), 0.3
    part.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "anchor.transform.x", x, 1000#: Near "anchor.transform.y", y, -1930#
    Near "anchor.source.unchanged", path.Length, 150# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    Set path = CirclePath
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Wrap", "Circumference", 0.75, "Circumference", 0.25)
    Check "anchor.wrap.count", part.segmentCount = 2 And Not part.IsClosed
    Check "anchor.wrap.unique.ids", part.segmentID(1) <> part.segmentID(2)
    Check "anchor.wrap.source", part.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Circumference" And part.sourceSegmentID(2) = "Circumference"
    Near "anchor.wrap.length", part.Length, 10# * GEOM_PI
    Near "anchor.wrap.first.start", part.SourceStartParameter(1), 0.75
    Near "anchor.wrap.first.end", part.SourceEndParameter(1), 1#
    Near "anchor.wrap.second.start", part.SourceStartParameter(2), 0#
    Near "anchor.wrap.second.end", part.SourceEndParameter(2), 0.25
    part.AtDistance part.Length / 2#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "anchor.wrap.no.chord.x", x, 10#: Near "anchor.wrap.no.chord.y", y, 0#
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Reverse", "Circumference", 0.75, "Circumference", 0.25, False)
    Check "anchor.reverse.count", part.segmentCount = 1
    Near "anchor.reverse.length", part.Length, 10# * GEOM_PI
    Near "anchor.reverse.first", part.SourceStartParameter(1), 0.75
    Near "anchor.reverse.last", part.SourceEndParameter(1), 0.25
    part.AtDistance part.Length / 2#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "anchor.reverse.other.side.x", x, -10#: Near "anchor.reverse.other.side.y", y, 0#
    part.CopySegment 1, edge: Near "anchor.reverse.sweep", edge.sweep, -GEOM_PI
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Loop", "Circumference", 0.25, "Circumference", 0.25, True, True)
    Check "anchor.full.loop.closed", part.IsClosed And part.segmentCount = 2
    Near "anchor.full.loop.length", part.Length, path.Length
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Seam", "Circumference", 1#, "Circumference", 0#, True, True)
    Check "anchor.seam.loop.closed", part.IsClosed And part.segmentCount = 1
    Near "anchor.seam.loop.length", part.Length, path.Length
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("SeamReverse", "Circumference", 0#, "Circumference", 1#, False, True)
    Check "anchor.seam.reverse.closed", part.IsClosed
    Near "anchor.seam.reverse.source.first", part.SourceStartParameter(1), 1#
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Sharp", polygonSpec)
    Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("NamedSide", "Edge.BR", 0#, "Edge.TR", 0#)
    Check "anchor.zero.radius.named.edge", part.segmentCount = 1 And part.segmentID(1) = "Edge.BR"
    Near "anchor.zero.radius.length", part.Length, 80#
    ' Нулевая дуга не является сегментом, но её границы сохраняют стык.
    Check "anchor.zero.radius.no.phantom", Not path.HasSegmentID("Corner.BL")
    Near "anchor.zero.radius.junction.start", path.AnchorStation("Corner.BL", 0#), path.AnchorStation("Edge.BL", 0#)
    Near "anchor.zero.radius.junction.end", path.AnchorStation("Corner.BL", 1#), path.AnchorStation("Edge.BL", 0#)
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "AnchorFixture"
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Outer", polygonSpec)
    facade.outer "Concrete", path.id
    Set part = facade.chain("Side", "Outer", "Edge.BR", 0#, "Edge.TR", 0#)
    Set changed = facade.Transform("MovedSide", "Side", 1000000#, -1000000#)
    Set definition = facade.Finish
    Check "anchor.facade.registered", definition.PathCount = 3 And definition.IsSealed
    Check "anchor.facade.source", changed.sourcePathID(1) = "Outer" And changed.sourceSegmentID(1) = "Edge.BR"
    changed.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "anchor.facade.moved.x", x, 1000100#: Near "anchor.facade.moved.y", y, -1000000#
    For scenario = 0 To 9: Check "anchor.invalid." & CStr(scenario), InvalidAnchorRejected(scenario): Next scenario
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "anchor.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunPathAnchorTests = mReport & "TOTAL PATH ANCHORS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function InvalidAnchorRejected(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath, query As CSectionGeometryQuery, station As Double
    Set path = CirclePath
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0: station = path.AnchorStation("Missing")
        Case 1: station = path.AnchorStation("Circumference", -0.1)
        Case 2: station = path.AnchorStation("Circumference", 1.1)
        Case 3: Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Same", "Circumference", 0.25, "Circumference", 0.25)
        Case 4: Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Seam", "Circumference", 1#, "Circumference", 0#)
        Case 5: Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("Seam", "Circumference", 0#, "Circumference", 1#)
        Case 6
            Set path = CompoundPath
            Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("WrongDirection", "Right", 0#, "Bottom", 0#)
        Case 7
            Set path = CompoundPath
            Set part = path.BetweenAnchors("OpenLoop", "Bottom", 0.5, "Bottom", 0.5, True, True)
        Case 8
            Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Sharp", polygonSpec)
            station = path.segmentIndex("Corner.BL")
        Case 9: Set part = path.WithID("")
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    InvalidAnchorRejected = (Err.source = "CGeometryPath" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5520)
End Function

Public Function RunPathTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    TestLine
    TestArcs
    TestCompoundPath
    TestJointTangents
    TestSegmentation
    TestRays
    Dim scenario As Long
    For scenario = 0 To 13
        Check "path.invalid." & CStr(scenario), InvalidPathRejected(scenario)
    Next scenario
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "path.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunPathTests = mReport & "TOTAL ANALYTIC PATHS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: общий алгоритм скругления, включая вогнутые вершины и нулевой радиус.
Public Function RunRoundedPolygonTests() As String
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, path As CGeometryPath, region As CConcreteRegion
    Dim edge As TRegionEdge, i As Long, Radius As Double, scenario As Long
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 10#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Outer", polygonSpec)
    Check "rounded.count", path.segmentCount = 8
    Check "rounded.closed", path.IsClosed
    Near "rounded.length", path.Length, 280# + 20# * GEOM_PI
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "rounded.area", region.area, 8000# - 400# + 100# * GEOM_PI
    For i = 1 To path.segmentCount
        path.CopySegment i, edge
        If edge.sweep <> 0# Then
            Radius = Sqr((edge.x1 - edge.centerX) ^ 2 + (edge.y1 - edge.centerY) ^ 2)
            Near "rounded.radius." & CStr(i), Radius, 10#
            Near "rounded.sweep." & CStr(i), edge.sweep, GEOM_PI / 2#
        End If
    Next i
    Check "rounded.named.edge", path.segmentID(path.segmentIndex("Edge.BR")) = "Edge.BR"
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 20#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 5#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Mixed", polygonSpec)
    Check "rounded.zero.radius.count", path.segmentCount = 7
    Check "rounded.zero.radius.edge", path.segmentIndex("Edge.BL") = 1
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "rounded.individual.area", region.area, 8000# - 525# * (1# - GEOM_PI / 4#)
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Sharp", polygonSpec)
    Near "rounded.sharp.length", path.Length, 360#
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "rounded.sharp.area", region.area, 8000#
    ' Вогнутый угол сохраняет противоположное направление своей дуги.
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 200#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "Arm", 200#, 100#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "Inside", 100#, 100#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 200#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 200#, 10#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Concave", polygonSpec)
    path.CopySegment path.segmentIndex("Corner.Inside"), edge
    Near "rounded.concave.sweep", edge.sweep, -GEOM_PI / 2#
    Near "rounded.concave.cx", edge.centerX, 110#: Near "rounded.concave.cy", edge.centerY, 110#
    Near "rounded.concave.start.x", edge.x1, 110#: Near "rounded.concave.start.y", edge.y1, 100#
    Near "rounded.concave.end.x", edge.x2, 100#: Near "rounded.concave.end.y", edge.y2, 110#
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "rounded.concave.area", region.area, 30000# - 400# * (1# - GEOM_PI / 4#)
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 10#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 10#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Clockwise", polygonSpec)
    path.CopySegment path.segmentIndex("Corner.BL"), edge
    Near "rounded.clockwise.sweep", edge.sweep, -GEOM_PI / 2#
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "rounded.clockwise.area", region.area, 8000# - 400# + 100# * GEOM_PI
    ' Касание соседних дуг допустимо; исчезнувшая прямая не выбирается по индексу.
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 50#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 50#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 100#, 50#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 100#, 50#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Touching", polygonSpec)
    Check "rounded.touching.count", path.segmentCount = 4
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "rounded.touching.area", region.area, 2500# * GEOM_PI
    For scenario = 0 To 5
        Check "rounded.invalid." & CStr(scenario), InvalidPolygonRejected(scenario)
    Next scenario
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "rounded.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunRoundedPolygonTests = mReport & "TOTAL ROUNDED POLYGONS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: точные offset-дуги, вогнутый угол и независимость от обхода.
Public Function RunRoundedOffsetTests() As String
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, path As CGeometryPath, region As CConcreteRegion
    Dim original As CGeometryPath, originalRegion As CConcreteRegion, edge As TRegionEdge
    Dim vertices As Variant, radii As Variant, names As Variant, scenario As Long, x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    radii = Array(10#, 10#, 10#, 10#)
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 1))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set original = query.RoundedPolygon("Base", polygonSpec)
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 1))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Inward", polygonSpec, 5#)
    Check "offset.closed", path.IsClosed And path.segmentCount = 8
    Near "offset.rectangle.length", path.Length, 280# + 10# * GEOM_PI
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "offset.rectangle.area", region.area, 6300# - 100# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    path.CopySegment path.segmentIndex("Corner.BL"), edge
    Near "offset.rectangle.radius", Sqr((edge.x1 - edge.centerX) ^ 2 + (edge.y1 - edge.centerY) ^ 2), 5#
    Near "offset.rectangle.center.x", edge.centerX, 10#: Near "offset.rectangle.center.y", edge.centerY, 10#
    Near "offset.original.unchanged", original.Length, 280# + 20# * GEOM_PI
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))

    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Outward", polygonSpec, -5#)
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "offset.outward.area", region.area, 9900# - 900# + 225# * GEOM_PI
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 1))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("VanishedArc", polygonSpec, 15#)
    Check "offset.vanished.arc.count", path.segmentCount = 4
    Check "offset.vanished.arc.named.edge", path.segmentID(path.segmentIndex("Edge.BL")) = "Edge.BL"
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path)
    Near "offset.vanished.arc.area", region.area, 3500#
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 0#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("SharpOutward", polygonSpec, -5#)
    Check "offset.sharp.preserved", path.segmentCount = 4
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path): Near "offset.sharp.area", region.area, 9900#
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 1))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Clockwise", polygonSpec, 5#)
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path): Near "offset.clockwise.area", region.area, 6300# - 100# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    path.CopySegment path.segmentIndex("Corner.BL"), edge
    Near "offset.clockwise.sweep", edge.sweep, -GEOM_PI / 2#
    vertices = Array(Array(0#, 0#), Array(100#, 0#), Array(100#, 40#), Array(40#, 40#), Array(40#, 100#), Array(0#, 100#))
    radii = Array(5#, 5#, 5#, 5#, 5#, 5#): names = Array("BL", "BR", "Arm", "Inside", "TR", "TL")
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 0)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 1)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 1))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 2)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 3)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 4)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 4)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 4))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 5)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 5)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 5))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set original = query.RoundedPolygon("ConcaveBase", polygonSpec)
    Set originalRegion = query.RegionFromPath(original)
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 0)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 0))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 1)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 1))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 2)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 2))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 3)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 3))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 4)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 4)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 4))
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 5)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(names(LBound(names) + 5)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), CDbl(radii(LBound(radii) + 5))
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("ConcaveOffset", polygonSpec, 2#)
    path.CopySegment path.segmentIndex("Corner.Inside"), edge
    Near "offset.concave.radius", Sqr((edge.x1 - edge.centerX) ^ 2 + (edge.y1 - edge.centerY) ^ 2), 7#
    Near "offset.concave.center.x", edge.centerX, 45#: Near "offset.concave.center.y", edge.centerY, 45#
    Near "offset.concave.sweep", edge.sweep, -GEOM_PI / 2#
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path): Near "offset.concave.area", region.area, 5616# + 4# - GEOM_PI
    path.AtDistance path.Length / 7#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "offset.boundary.distance", query.boundaryDistance(originalRegion, x, y), 2#
    vertices = Array(Array(1000000#, -1000000#), Array(1000100#, -1000000#), _
        Array(1000100#, -999920#), Array(1000000#, -999920#))
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 10#
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 10#
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 10#
    polygonPoint = vertices(LBound(vertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 10#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Far", polygonSpec, 5#)
    Set region = query.RegionFromPath(path): Near "offset.far.area", region.area, 6300# - 100# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    path.CopySegment path.segmentIndex("Corner.BL"), edge
    Near "offset.far.center.x", edge.centerX, 1000010#: Near "offset.far.center.y", edge.centerY, -999990#
    For scenario = 0 To 2: Check "offset.invalid." & CStr(scenario), InvalidOffsetRejected(scenario): Next scenario
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "offset.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunRoundedOffsetTests = mReport & "TOTAL ROUNDED OFFSET: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function InvalidOffsetRejected(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, path As CGeometryPath
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 10#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Collapsed", polygonSpec, 50#)
        Case 1
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 10#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Reversed", polygonSpec, 100#)
        Case 2
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 60#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 60#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 60#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 60#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.OffsetRoundedPolygon("InvalidBase", polygonSpec, 50#)
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    InvalidOffsetRejected = (Err.source = "CSectionGeometryQuery" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5401)
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: чтение in-memory ввода и независимость от исходных массивов.
Public Function RunInputTableTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim cells(1 To 4, 1 To 3) As Variant, addresses(1 To 4, 1 To 3) As String, row As Long, column As Long
    Dim table As CSectionInputTable, units As CUnitSystem, scenario As Long
    cells(1, 1) = "Key": cells(1, 2) = "Value": cells(1, 3) = "Mode"
    cells(2, 1) = "Count": cells(2, 2) = 4#: cells(2, 3) = "stacked"
    cells(3, 1) = "Disabled": cells(3, 2) = 0#
    cells(4, 1) = "Diameter": cells(4, 2) = 16#
    For row = 1 To 4
        For column = 1 To 3
            addresses(row, column) = "Config!" & Chr$(64 + column) & CStr(row + 10)
        Next column
    Next row
    Set table = New CSectionInputTable: table.Initialize "rngFixture", cells, addresses
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.InitializeDefaults
    Check "input.rows", table.rowCount = 4
    Check "input.columns", table.columnCount = 3
    Check "input.caption", table.ColumnByCaption(1, "value") = 2
    Check "input.key", table.RowByKey("diameter") = 4
    Check "input.key.scoped", table.RowByKey("Count", 1, 2, 3) = 2
    Check "input.key.alias", table.RowByAnyKey(Array("Unknown", "Diameter"), 1, 3, 4) = 4
    Near "input.number", table.number(2, 2), 4#
    Check "input.count", table.count(2, 2) = 4
    Check "input.choice", table.Choice(2, 3, Array("Stacked", "SideBySide")) = "Stacked"
    Check "input.choice.default", table.Choice(4, 3, Array("Stacked", "SideBySide"), "SideBySide") = "SideBySide"
    Check "input.source", table.SourceReference(2, 2) = "Config!B12"
    Check "input.blank", table.IsBlank(4, 3)
    Near "input.number.default", table.number(4, 3, 7#), 7#
    Near "input.optional.zero", table.OptionalDiameter(3, 2, units), 0#
    Near "input.optional.blank", table.OptionalDiameter(3, 3, units), 0#
    Near "input.optional.active", table.OptionalDiameter(4, 2, units), 16#
    Near "input.length", table.Length(4, 2, units), 16#
    cells(2, 2) = 999#: addresses(2, 2) = "Changed"
    Near "input.value.immutable", table.number(2, 2), 4#
    Check "input.source.immutable", table.SourceReference(2, 2) = "Config!B12"
    cells(2, 2) = 2147483647#: addresses(2, 2) = "Config!B12"
    Set table = New CSectionInputTable: table.Initialize "rngLongBoundary", cells, addresses
    Check "input.count.maxLong", table.count(2, 2) = 2147483647
    For scenario = 0 To 24
        Check "input.invalid." & CStr(scenario), InvalidInputRejected(scenario)
    Next scenario
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "input.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunInputTableTests = mReport & "TOTAL INPUT TABLES: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function InvalidInputRejected(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim cells(1 To 2, 1 To 2) As Variant, table As CSectionInputTable, value As Variant, units As CUnitSystem
    cells(1, 1) = "Key": cells(1, 2) = "Value": cells(2, 1) = "Count": cells(2, 2) = 4#
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0: cells(2, 2) = "four"
        Case 1: cells(2, 2) = -1#
        Case 2: cells(2, 2) = 1.5
        Case 3: cells(2, 2) = 2147483648#
        Case 4: cells(2, 2) = True
        Case 5: cells(2, 2) = CVErr(2042)
        Case 6: cells(1, 1) = "Value"
        Case 7: cells(1, 1) = "Count"
        Case 8: cells(2, 2) = Empty
        Case 9: cells(2, 2) = "Unknown"
        Case 13: cells(2, 2) = -1#
        Case 14: cells(2, 2) = Array(1#, 2#)
        Case 15: Set cells(2, 2) = New CUnitSystem
        Case 22: cells(2, 2) = "-"
        Case 23: cells(2, 2) = "TODO"
        Case 24: cells(2, 2) = "diameter"
    End Select
    Set table = New CSectionInputTable: table.Initialize "rngInvalid", cells
    Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.InitializeDefaults
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0, 4, 5, 8: value = table.number(2, 2)
        Case 1, 2, 3: value = table.count(2, 2)
        Case 6: value = table.ColumnByCaption(1, "Value")
        Case 7: value = table.RowByKey("Count")
        Case 9: value = table.Choice(2, 2, Array("Stacked", "SideBySide"))
        Case 10: table.Initialize "Second", cells
        Case 11: value = table.number(3, 2)
        Case 12: value = table.RowByKey("Missing")
        Case 13, 22, 23, 24: value = table.OptionalDiameter(2, 2, units)
        Case 16: value = table.ColumnByCaption(1, "Missing")
        Case 17: value = table.RowByKey("Count", 1, 2, 1)
        Case 18: value = table.RowByKey("Count", 1, 3, 4)
        Case 19: value = table.RowByAnyKey(Array("Key", "Count"))
        Case 20: value = table.RowByAnyKey("Count")
        Case 21: value = table.RowByAnyKey(Array(""))
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    InvalidInputRejected = (Err.source = "CSectionInputTable" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5525)
    If scenario = 0 Then InvalidInputRejected = InvalidInputRejected And InStr(1, Err.description, "rngInvalid[2,2]", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
    If scenario >= 22 Then InvalidInputRejected = InvalidInputRejected And InStr(1, Err.description, "rngInvalid[2,2]", vbBinaryCompare) > 0
End Function

Private Function InvalidPolygonRejected(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, path As CGeometryPath
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, -1#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Negative", polygonSpec)
        Case 1
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 60#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 60#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 100#, 80#, 60#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 80#, 60#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Overlap", polygonSpec)
        Case 2
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "A", 0#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "A", 100#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "B", 100#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "C", 0#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Duplicate", polygonSpec)
        Case 3
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "A", 0#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "B", 50#, 0#, 10#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "C", 100#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "D", 100#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "E", 0#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Collinear", polygonSpec)
        Case 4
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Missing", polygonSpec)
        Case 5
            Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "BR", 100#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TR", 0#, 80#, 0#
            polygonSpec.AddVertex "TL", 100#, 0#, 0#
            polygonSpec.Seal
            Set path = query.RoundedPolygon("Crossed", polygonSpec)
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    If scenario = 0 Or scenario = 2 Or scenario = 4 Then
        ' Структура теперь проверяется описателем до передачи геометрическому ядру.
        InvalidPolygonRejected = (Err.source = "CPolygonSpec" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5470)
    Else
        InvalidPolygonRejected = (Err.source = "CSectionGeometryQuery" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5401)
    End If
End Function

Private Sub TestLine()
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, changed As CGeometryPath
    Dim x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, minimum As Double, maximum As Double
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Outer.Inclined"
    path.AddLine "Inclined", 0#, 0#, 3#, 4#: path.Seal
    Near "line.length", path.Length, 5#
    path.AtDistance 2.5, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "line.x", x, 1.5: Near "line.y", y, 2#
    Near "line.tx", tx, 0.6: Near "line.ty", ty, 0.8
    path.ProjectionBounds 2#, 0#, minimum, maximum
    Near "line.minimum", minimum, 0#: Near "line.maximum", maximum, 3#
    Set changed = path.reversed
    changed.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "line.reverse.x", x, 3#: Near "line.reverse.y", y, 4#
    Near "line.reverse.tx", tx, -0.6: Near "line.reverse.ty", ty, -0.8
    Set changed = path.transformed(10#, 20#, GEOM_PI / 2#)
    changed.AtDistance changed.Length, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "line.rotate.x", x, 6#: Near "line.rotate.y", y, 23#
    Near "line.rotate.tx", tx, -0.8: Near "line.rotate.ty", ty, 0.6
    Check "line.transform.id", changed.segmentID(1) = "Inclined"
    Near "line.transform.length", changed.Length, path.Length
    Check "line.sealed", changed.IsSealed And path.IsSealed
    Check "line.open", Not changed.IsClosed
End Sub

Private Sub TestArcs()
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, changed As CGeometryPath, edge As TRegionEdge
    Dim x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, minimum As Double, maximum As Double
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Arc.Positive"
    path.AddArc "Curve", 0#, 0#, 10#, GEOM_PI / 4#, GEOM_PI: path.Seal
    Near "arc.length", path.Length, 10# * GEOM_PI
    path.AtDistance path.Length / 4#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "arc.internal.x", x, 0#: Near "arc.internal.y", y, 10#
    Near "arc.internal.tx", tx, -1#: Near "arc.internal.ty", ty, 0#
    path.ProjectionBounds 0#, 1#, minimum, maximum
    Near "arc.bounds.y.min", minimum, -10# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "arc.bounds.y.max", maximum, 10#
    path.ProjectionBounds 1#, 0#, minimum, maximum
    Near "arc.bounds.x.min", minimum, -10#
    Near "arc.bounds.x.max", maximum, 10# / Sqr(2#)
    Set changed = path.reversed
    changed.AtDistance changed.Length, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "arc.reverse.end.x", x, 10# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "arc.reverse.end.y", y, 10# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "arc.reverse.end.tx", tx, 1# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "arc.reverse.end.ty", ty, -1# / Sqr(2#)
    Set changed = path.transformed(1000000#, -1000000#, 0#, True)
    changed.CopySegment 1, edge
    Near "arc.reflection.sweep", edge.sweep, -GEOM_PI
    changed.AtDistance changed.Length / 4#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "arc.reflection.x", x, 1000000#
    Near "arc.reflection.y", y, -1000010#
    Near "arc.reflection.length", changed.Length, path.Length
    Check "arc.reflection.id", changed.segmentID(1) = path.segmentID(1)
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Arc.Negative"
    path.AddArc "Curve", 0#, 0#, 10#, GEOM_PI / 4#, -GEOM_PI: path.Seal
    path.AtDistance path.Length / 4#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "arc.negative.x", x, 10#: Near "arc.negative.y", y, 0#
    Near "arc.negative.tx", tx, 0#: Near "arc.negative.ty", ty, -1#
    path.ProjectionBounds 1#, 0#, minimum, maximum
    Near "arc.negative.max", maximum, 10#
    Near "arc.negative.min", minimum, -10# / Sqr(2#)
    Set path = CirclePath
    Check "circle.closed", path.IsClosed
    Near "circle.length", path.Length, 20# * GEOM_PI
    path.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "circle.start.x", x, 10#: Near "circle.start.y", y, 0#
    path.AtDistance path.Length, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "circle.end.x", x, 10#: Near "circle.end.y", y, 0#
    path.ProjectionBounds 0#, 1#, minimum, maximum
    Near "circle.min", minimum, -10#: Near "circle.max", maximum, 10#
End Sub

Private Sub TestCompoundPath()
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath
    Dim x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double
    Set path = CompoundPath
    Near "compound.length", path.Length, 150# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    Check "compound.count", path.segmentCount = 3
    path.AtDistance 100# + 12.5 * GEOM_PI, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "compound.arc.x", x, 100# + 50# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "compound.arc.y", y, 50# - 50# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "compound.arc.tx", tx, 1# / Sqr(2#)
    Near "compound.arc.ty", ty, 1# / Sqr(2#)
    path.AtDistance 100#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "compound.join.x", x, 100#: Near "compound.join.y", y, 0#
    Near "compound.join.tx", tx, 1#: Near "compound.join.ty", ty, 0#
    Set part = path.Slice(50#, path.Length - 25#)
    Near "compound.slice.length", part.Length, path.Length - 75#
    Check "compound.slice.segments", part.segmentCount = 3
    Check "compound.slice.id", part.segmentID(2) = "Corner"
    part.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "compound.slice.start.x", x, 50#: Near "compound.slice.start.y", y, 0#
    part.AtDistance part.Length, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "compound.slice.end.x", x, 150#: Near "compound.slice.end.y", y, 75#
    Near "compound.source.unchanged", path.Length, 150# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    Set part = path.transformed(1000#, -2000#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True)
    part.AtDistance part.Length, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "compound.transform.x", x, 1100#: Near "compound.transform.y", y, -1850#
    Near "compound.transform.tx", tx, 1#: Near "compound.transform.ty", ty, 0#
End Sub

' G09: разбиение той же дуги на 25 частей не меняет точки или касательные.
Private Sub TestJointTangents()
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Joint"
    path.AddLine "Incoming", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#
    path.AddLine "Outgoing", 100#, 0#, 100#, 100#
    path.Seal
    path.AtDistance 100#, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "joint.default.tx", tx, 0#: Near "joint.default.ty", ty, 1#
    path.AtDistance 100#, x, y, tx, ty, True
    Near "joint.incoming.x", x, 100#: Near "joint.incoming.y", y, 0#
    Near "joint.incoming.tx", tx, 1#: Near "joint.incoming.ty", ty, 0#
    path.AtDistance 100# + GEOM_TOLERANCE / 2#, x, y, tx, ty, True
    Near "joint.roundoff.x", x, 100#: Near "joint.roundoff.y", y, 0#
    path.AtDistance 100# + 2# * GEOM_TOLERANCE, x, y, tx, ty, True
    Near "joint.after.tx", tx, 0#: Near "joint.after.ty", ty, 1#
End Sub

Private Sub TestSegmentation()
    Dim whole As CGeometryPath, split As CGeometryPath, i As Long, startAngle As Double, sweep As Double
    Dim x1 As Double, y1 As Double, tx1 As Double, ty1 As Double, x2 As Double, y2 As Double, tx2 As Double, ty2 As Double
    startAngle = 7# * GEOM_PI / 4#: sweep = 5# * GEOM_PI / 4#
    Set whole = New CGeometryPath: whole.Initialize "Whole"
    whole.AddArc "Curve", 25#, -40#, 100#, startAngle, sweep: whole.Seal
    Set split = New CGeometryPath: split.Initialize "Split"
    For i = 0 To 24
        split.AddArc "Curve." & CStr(i), 25#, -40#, 100#, startAngle + sweep * CDbl(i) / 25#, sweep / 25#
    Next i
    split.Seal
    Near "split.length", split.Length, whole.Length
    For i = 0 To 40
        whole.AtDistance whole.Length * CDbl(i) / 40#, x1, y1, tx1, ty1
        split.AtDistance split.Length * CDbl(i) / 40#, x2, y2, tx2, ty2
        Near "split.x." & CStr(i), x2, x1
        Near "split.y." & CStr(i), y2, y1
        Near "split.tx." & CStr(i), tx2, tx1
        Near "split.ty." & CStr(i), ty2, ty1
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub TestRays()
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, station As Double, distance As Double
    Set path = CirclePath
    Check "ray.circle.hit", path.RayHit(-20#, 0#, 2#, 0#, station, distance)
    Near "ray.circle.nearest", distance, 10#
    Near "ray.circle.station", station, 10# * GEOM_PI
    Check "ray.circle.away", Not path.RayHit(-20#, 0#, -1#, 0#, station, distance)
    Check "ray.circle.tangent", path.RayHit(-20#, 10#, 1#, 0#, station, distance)
    Near "ray.circle.tangent.distance", distance, 20#
    Set path = CompoundPath
    Check "ray.compound.hit", path.RayHit(200#, 75#, -1#, 0#, station, distance)
    Near "ray.compound.distance", distance, 50#
    Near "ray.compound.station", station, 125# + 25# * GEOM_PI
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Limited"
    path.AddLine "Line", 0#, 0#, 3#, 4#: path.Seal
    Check "ray.line.beyond.target", Not path.RayHit(10#, 10#, 0#, -1#, station, distance)
    Check "ray.line.collinear", path.RayHit(1.5, 2#, 0.6, 0.8, station, distance)
    Near "ray.line.collinear.distance", distance, 0#
    Near "ray.line.collinear.station", station, 2.5
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "LimitedArc"
    path.AddArc "Curve", 0#, 0#, 10#, GEOM_PI / 4#, GEOM_PI: path.Seal
    Check "ray.arc.beyond.target", Not path.RayHit(0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, station, distance)
End Sub

Private Function CirclePath() As CGeometryPath
    Dim path As CGeometryPath
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Circle"
    path.AddArc "Circumference", 0#, 0#, 10#, 0#, 2# * GEOM_PI: path.Seal True
    Set CirclePath = path
End Function

Private Function CompoundPath() As CGeometryPath
    Dim path As CGeometryPath
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Outer.Mixed"
    path.AddLine "Bottom", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#
    path.AddArc "Corner", 100#, 50#, 50#, -GEOM_PI / 2#, GEOM_PI / 2#
    path.AddLine "Right", 150#, 50#, 150#, 100#: path.Seal
    Set CompoundPath = path
End Function

Private Function InvalidPathRejected(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, part As CGeometryPath, edge As TRegionEdge, value As Double, x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Invalid"
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0
            path.AddLine "Duplicate", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.AddLine "Duplicate", 1#, 0#, 2#, 0#
        Case 1
            path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.AddLine "Disconnected", 2#, 0#, 3#, 0#
        Case 2: path.AddArc "NegativeRadius", 0#, 0#, -1#, 0#, 1#
        Case 3: path.AddArc "ZeroSweep", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 0#
        Case 4: path.AddArc "DoubleTurn", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 4# * GEOM_PI
        Case 5: path.AddLine "Open", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal True
        Case 6: value = path.Length
        Case 7: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: path.AddLine "Late", 1#, 0#, 2#, 0#
        Case 8: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: path.AtDistance -1#, x, y, tx, ty
        Case 9: path.Seal
        Case 10: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: Set part = path.Slice(0.5, 0.5)
        Case 11: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: path.ProjectionBounds 0#, 0#, x, y
        Case 12: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.Seal: value = path.segmentIndex("Missing")
        Case 13: path.AddLine "First", 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#: path.CopySegment 1, edge
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    InvalidPathRejected = (Err.source = "CGeometryPath" And Err.number = vbObjectError + 5520)
End Function

Private Sub Near(ByVal Name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    Check Name & "; actual=" & format$(actual, "0.000000000000000") & "; expected=" & format$(expected, "0.000000000000000"), _
        Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.0000001
End Sub

Private Sub Check(ByVal Name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1: mReport = mReport & "PASS: " & Name & vbCrLf
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & Name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

COMPONENT: CSectionInputTable
