Option Explicit

' Обновляет только список Geometry.Type по реестру; структура готовой книги уже актуальна.
Public Sub UpdateSectionRecipeTypes()
    Dim table As Object, list As Object, target As Object, cell As Object, ids As Variant, values() As Variant
    Dim count As Long, row As Long, i As Long, guard As CExcelAppStateGuard
    Dim number As Long, source As String, description As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set table = RequiredTable("rngSystemSettings")
    Set list = RequiredTable("rngSectionRecipeTypes")
    If list.areas.count <> 1 Or list.columns.count <> 1 Then _
        SectionRecipeError "modSectionRecipeSetup", "Именованный список rngSectionRecipeTypes должен занимать один непрерывный столбец."
    If Not list.Worksheet Is table.Worksheet Then _
        SectionRecipeError "modSectionRecipeSetup", "Список rngSectionRecipeTypes должен находиться на листе системных настроек."
    For i = 2 To table.rows.count
        If Not IsError(table.cells(i, 1).value2) Then
            If CStr(table.cells(i, 1).value2) = "Geometry.Type" Then
                If row > 0 Then SectionRecipeError "modSectionRecipeSetup", "В rngSystemSettings повторяется ключ Geometry.Type."
                row = i
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    If row = 0 Then SectionRecipeError "modSectionRecipeSetup", "В rngSystemSettings отсутствует ключ Geometry.Type."
    Set cell = table.cells(row, 2)
    ids = RegisteredSectionRecipeTypes: count = UBound(ids) - LBound(ids) + 1
    Set target = list.cells(1, 1).Resize(count, 1)
    ' Новый тип занимает только свободное продолжение служебного списка; чужие данные не заменяются.
    For i = list.rows.count + 1 To count
        If Len(CStr(target.cells(i, 1).formula)) > 0 Then _
            SectionRecipeError "modSectionRecipeSetup", "Продолжение списка типов занято: " & target.Worksheet.Name & "!" & target.cells(i, 1).address(False, False) & ". Освободите ячейку или перенесите именованный список."
    Next i
    ReDim values(1 To count, 1 To 1)
    For i = 1 To count: values(i, 1) = ids(LBound(ids) + i - 1): Next i
    Set guard = New CExcelAppStateGuard: guard.Enter ThisWorkbook.Application
    If list.rows.count > count Then list.cells(count + 1, 1).Resize(list.rows.count - count, 1).ClearContents
    target.value2 = values
    If list.rows.count <> count Then ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = _
        "='" & Replace$(target.Worksheet.Name, "'", "''") & "'!" & target.address(True, True, xlA1)
    cell.validation.Delete
    cell.validation.Add xlValidateList, xlValidAlertStop, xlBetween, "=rngSectionRecipeTypes"
    cell.validation.IgnoreBlank = False: cell.validation.InCellDropdown = True
    guard.Restore True
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    number = Err.number: source = Err.source: description = Err.description
    If Not guard Is Nothing Then guard.Restore
    Err.Raise number, source, description
End Sub

' Читает реестр без обращения к таблицам геометрии или запуска построения сечения.
Public Function RegisteredSectionRecipeTypes() As Variant
    Dim registry As CSectionTypeRegistry: Set registry = New CSectionTypeRegistry
    RegisteredSectionRecipeTypes = registry.RegisteredRecipeTypes
End Function

' Повреждённое имя требует восстановления; отсутствующие таблицы здесь не создаются.
Private Function RequiredTable(ByVal Name As String) As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set RequiredTable = ThisWorkbook.names(Name).RefersToRange
    On Error GoTo 0
    If RequiredTable Is Nothing Then SectionRecipeError "modSectionRecipeSetup", "Не найден диапазон '" & Name & "'. Восстановите именованный диапазон Config."
End Function



====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: modTestRecipeSetbacks
TYPE: 1
LINES: 284

Option Explicit

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: реальные редактируемые отступы Config и их влияние на общий
' рецепт, включая фильтр проекций Opening. НДС в этом наборе не решается.
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: те же внутренние координаты при вводе отступов в мм/см/м.
Public Function RunRecipeSetbackUnitTests() As String
    Dim values As Variant, baseline As Variant, scaled As Variant, table As CSectionInputTable
    Dim sheet As Object, setting As Object, settings As CSystemSettingsReader, units As CUnitSystem
    Dim recipe As ISectionRecipe, definition As CSectionDefinition, expected As CRebarLayout, actual As CRebarLayout
    Dim main As Long, extra As Long, row As Long, column As Long, i As Long, item As Variant, factor As Double
    Dim alerts As Boolean, itemColumn As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = "": alerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    values = ThisWorkbook.names("rngRoundedRectangleGeometry").RefersToRange.value2
    Set table = New CSectionInputTable: table.Initialize "rngRoundedRectangleGeometry", values
    main = table.RowByKey("as", 2): extra = table.RowByKey("d2", 2)
    values(3, 2) = 800#: values(3, 3) = 250#
    values(7, 2) = "Simple": values(7, 3) = "Tapered"
    values(8, 2) = 0#: values(8, 3) = 150#
    values(9, 2) = 40#: values(9, 3) = 40#: values(10, 2) = 0#: values(10, 3) = 80#
    For row = main + 1 To main + 4
        values(row, 2) = 40#: values(row, 3) = 20#: values(row, 4) = 3
        values(row, 5) = 10#: values(row, 6) = 20#
    Next row
    For row = extra + 1 To extra + 4: values(row, 2) = 0#: values(row, 5) = 0#: Next row
    Set recipe = New CSectionRecipeRoundedRectangle
    Set expected = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(FixtureRecipeDefinition(recipe, "rngRoundedRectangleGeometry", values))
    baseline = values
    Set sheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add: Set setting = sheet.range("A1:C2")
    setting.cells(1, 1).value2 = "Key": setting.cells(1, 2).value2 = "Value": setting.cells(1, 3).value2 = "Unit"
    setting.cells(2, 1).value2 = "Units.Length.Input"
    For Each item In Array(Array("mm", 1#), Array("cm", 10#), Array("m", 1000#))
        factor = CDbl(item(1)): scaled = baseline
        For column = 2 To 3
            scaled(3, column) = CDbl(baseline(3, column)) / factor
            For row = 8 To 10: scaled(row, column) = CDbl(baseline(row, column)) / factor: Next row
        Next column
        For row = main + 1 To main + 4
            For Each itemColumn In Array(2, 3, 5, 6)
                scaled(row, CLng(itemColumn)) = CDbl(baseline(row, CLng(itemColumn))) / factor
            Next itemColumn
        Next row
        setting.cells(2, 2).value2 = CStr(item(0))
        Set settings = New CSystemSettingsReader: settings.LoadFromRange setting
        Set units = New CUnitSystem: units.LoadFromSettings settings
        Set definition = FixtureRecipeDefinition(recipe, "rngRoundedRectangleGeometry", scaled, units)
        Set actual = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition)
        Check "setback.units.count." & CStr(item(0)), actual.count = expected.count
        For i = 1 To expected.count
            Near "setback.units.x." & CStr(item(0)) & "." & CStr(i), actual.x(i), expected.x(i)
            Near "setback.units.y." & CStr(item(0)) & "." & CStr(i), actual.y(i), expected.y(i)
        Next i
    Next item
    mReport = mReport & "TOTAL_RECIPE_SETBACK_UNITS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    If Not sheet Is Nothing Then sheet.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = alerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunRecipeSetbackUnitTests = mReport
    Exit Function
Failed:
    mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: units.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description & vbCrLf
    Resume Restore
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: обновление реестра не перестраивает Config и не требует таблиц геометрии.
Public Function RunRecipeTypeListTests() As String
    Dim config As Object, saved As Variant, expected As Variant, list As Object, ids As Variant
    Dim originalList As String, originalCircle As String, brokenCircle As String, i As Long, count As Long, Code As Long
    Dim calculation As Long, events As Boolean, updating As Boolean, alerts As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Failed
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    calculation = Application.calculation: events = Application.EnableEvents
    updating = Application.ScreenUpdating: alerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    Set config = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Config").UsedRange: saved = config.formula
    originalList = ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo
    originalCircle = ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo
    Set list = ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange
    ids = RegisteredSectionRecipeTypes: count = UBound(ids) - LBound(ids) + 1
    Application.calculation = xlCalculationManual: Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False: Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    ' Даже повреждённая чужая таблица не участвует в обновлении списка.
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo = "=#REF!"
    brokenCircle = ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo
    list.value2 = "stale choice": expected = config.formula
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    Check "types.config.outside.list", SameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, list.Resize(count, 1))
    Check "types.current.selection", SameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, saved, list.Resize(count, 1))
    Check "types.unrelated.name", ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo = brokenCircle
    For i = 1 To count: Check "types.registered." & CStr(i), list.cells(i, 1).value2 = ids(LBound(ids) + i - 1): Next i
    Check "types.state.success", Application.calculation = xlCalculationManual And Not Application.EnableEvents And Not Application.ScreenUpdating And Not Application.DisplayAlerts
    expected = config.formula: modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    Check "types.idempotent", SameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, Nothing)
    ' Сокращённый список расширяется только на свободные ячейки своего столбца.
    list.cells(count, 1).ClearContents
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=" & list.Resize(count - 1, 1).address(True, True, xlA1, True)
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    Check "types.grow", ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange.rows.count = count And list.cells(count, 1).value2 = ids(UBound(ids))
    ' Занятое продолжение отклоняется до записи значений и имени.
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=" & list.Resize(count - 1, 1).address(True, True, xlA1, True)
    list.cells(count, 1).value2 = "user data": expected = config.formula
    On Error Resume Next
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes: Code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Check "types.occupied.rejected", Code <> 0
    Check "types.occupied.data", SameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, Nothing)
    Check "types.occupied.name", ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange.rows.count = count - 1
    Check "types.state.failure", Application.calculation = xlCalculationManual And Not Application.EnableEvents And Not Application.ScreenUpdating And Not Application.DisplayAlerts
    ' Лишняя прежняя запись удаляется только из принадлежащего списку диапазона.
    ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=" & list.Resize(count + 1, 1).address(True, True, xlA1, True)
    list.cells(count + 1, 1).value2 = "removed type": modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes
    Check "types.shrink", ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersToRange.rows.count = count And IsEmpty(list.cells(count + 1, 1).value2)
    expected = config.formula: ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = "=#REF!": Code = 0
    On Error Resume Next
    modSectionRecipeSetup.UpdateSectionRecipeTypes: Code = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Check "types.missing.rejected", Code <> 0
    Check "types.missing.data", SameConfigOutsideTypeList(config, expected, Nothing)
    GoTo Restore
Failed:
    Check "types.runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Restore:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Len(originalList) > 0 Then ThisWorkbook.names("rngSectionRecipeTypes").RefersTo = originalList
    If Len(originalCircle) > 0 Then ThisWorkbook.names("rngCircleGeometry").RefersTo = originalCircle
    If Not config Is Nothing And Not IsEmpty(saved) Then config.formula = saved
    Application.calculation = calculation: Application.EnableEvents = events
    Application.ScreenUpdating = updating: Application.DisplayAlerts = alerts
    On Error GoTo 0
    RunRecipeTypeListTests = mReport & "TOTAL RECIPE TYPE LIST: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' Сравнивает весь Config, кроме явно разрешённого служебного списка.
Private Function SameConfigOutsideTypeList(ByVal config As Object, ByVal expected As Variant, ByVal list As Object) As Boolean
    Dim actual As Variant, row As Long, column As Long, sheetRow As Long, sheetColumn As Long, skip As Boolean
    actual = config.formula
    For row = 1 To UBound(expected, 1)
        For column = 1 To UBound(expected, 2)
            skip = False
            If Not list Is Nothing Then
                sheetRow = config.row + row - 1: sheetColumn = config.column + column - 1
                skip = sheetColumn = list.column And sheetRow >= list.row And sheetRow < list.row + list.rows.count
            End If
            If Not skip Then
                If VarType(actual(row, column)) <> VarType(expected(row, column)) Then Exit Function
                If CStr(actual(row, column)) <> CStr(expected(row, column)) Then Exit Function
            End If
        Next column
    Next row
    SameConfigOutsideTypeList = True
End Function

Public Function RunRecipeSetbackInputTests() As String
    Dim rounded As Object, hollow As Object, savedRounded As Variant, savedHollow As Variant
    Dim table As CSectionInputTable, row As Long, main As Long, def As CSectionDefinition
    Dim original As CRebarLayout, changed As CRebarLayout, region As CConcreteRegion

    mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: runtime; " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description & vbCrLf
    Resume Restore
End Function

Private Function groupCount(ByVal layout As CRebarLayout, ByVal group As String) As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To layout.count
        If InGroup(layout, i, group) Then groupCount = groupCount + 1
    Next i
End Function

Private Function ProjectedSubset(ByVal actual As CRebarLayout, ByVal original As CRebarLayout, ByVal group As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, found As Boolean
    For i = 1 To actual.count
        If InGroup(actual, i, group) Then
            found = False
            For j = 1 To original.count
                If InGroup(original, j, group) Then
                    If Abs(actual.x(i) - original.x(j)) < 0.000001 And Abs(actual.y(i) - original.y(j)) < 0.000001 Then found = True
                End If
            Next j
            If Not found Then Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
    ProjectedSubset = True
End Function

Private Function InGroup(ByVal layout As CRebarLayout, ByVal index As Long, ByVal group As String) As Boolean
    Dim membership As Variant
    For Each membership In layout.BarMemberships(index)
        If CStr(membership) = group Then InGroup = True: Exit Function
    Next membership
End Function

Private Sub Check(ByVal Name As String, ByVal condition As Boolean)
    If condition Then
        mPassed = mPassed + 1: mReport = mReport & "OK: " & Name & vbCrLf
    Else
        mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & Name & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Near(ByVal Name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    Check Name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000001
End Sub

Public Function RunArbitraryAnnotationGeometryTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim degrees As Variant, value As Variant, shape As Variant, angle As Double, nx As Double, ny As Double
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel
    Dim path As CGeometryPath, polygon As CPolygonSpec, options As CRebarRuleOptions, support As Double, mx As Double, my As Double
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, region As CConcreteRegion, distance As Double, prefix As String
    Dim annotationBuilder As CSectionAnnotationBuilder, repeated As CSectionAnnotations, count As Long
    degrees = Array(0#, 30#, 45#, 90#, 135#, 225#, 315#)
    For Each shape In Array("Circle", "Rounded", "HollowRectangle")
        For Each value In degrees
            angle = CDbl(value) * GEOM_PI / 180#: nx = Cos(angle): ny = Sin(angle)
            prefix = CStr(shape) & "." & CStr(value)
            Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "AngleFixture"
            If shape = "HollowRectangle" Then
                Set polygon = AngleRoundedPolygon(500#, 600#, 160#)
                Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("OuterBase", polygon)
                Set path = facade.Transform("Outer", path.id, 0#, 0#, angle)
            Else
                Set path = facade.CirclePath("Outer", 0#, 0#, 800#)
            End If
            facade.outer "OUTER", path.id
            Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.AnnotationGroup = "G"
            If shape = "Circle" Then
                Set path = facade.CirclePath("Axis", 0#, 0#, 150#)
                options.EndMode = ClosedUniform: support = 150#
                facade.RebarByCount "Bars", path.id, 8, 10#, options
            ElseIf shape = "Rounded" Then
                Set polygon = AngleRoundedPolygon(200#, 300#, 40#)
                Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Axis", polygon)
                options.EndMode = ClosedUniform
                support = 160# * Abs(nx) + 260# * Abs(ny) + 40#
                facade.RebarByCount "Bars", path.id, 12, 10#, options
            Else
                Set polygon = AngleRoundedPolygon(200#, 300#, 80#)
                Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("HoleBase", polygon)
                Set path = facade.Transform("Hole", path.id, 40#, 20#, angle)
                facade.opening "OPENING", path.id, "OUTER"
                Set path = facade.LinePath("AxisBase", -240#, -100#, -240#, 100#)
                Set path = facade.Transform("Axis", path.id, 40#, 20#, angle)
                facade.RebarByCount "Bars", path.id, 2, 10#, options
            End If
            facade.RebarLabel "G", path.id, 2# * nx, 2# * ny
            Set definition = facade.Finish: Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = BuildDefinition(definition, builder)
            Check prefix & ".one.group", model.Annotations.count = 1
            mx = 0.5 * (model.Annotations.startX(1) + model.Annotations.endX(1))
            my = 0.5 * (model.Annotations.startY(1) + model.Annotations.endY(1))
            If shape = "HollowRectangle" Then
                Near prefix & ".anchor.x", mx, 40# - 240# * nx
                Near prefix & ".anchor.y", my, 20# - 240# * ny
                Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery: Set region = query.RegionFromContours(model.Contours)
                Check prefix & ".hit", query.LabelBoundaryDistance(region, mx, my, nx, ny, distance)
                Near prefix & ".opening.not.outer", distance, 40#
                Check prefix & ".opening.role", model.Contours.loopRole(model.Contours.count) = "Opening"
            Else
                Near prefix & ".support.x", mx, support * nx
                Near prefix & ".support.y", my, support * ny
            End If
            Near prefix & ".line.perpendicular", (model.Annotations.endX(1) - model.Annotations.startX(1)) * nx + _
                (model.Annotations.endY(1) - model.Annotations.startY(1)) * ny, 0#
            count = model.RebarCount
            Set annotationBuilder = New CSectionAnnotationBuilder: Set repeated = New CSectionAnnotations
            annotationBuilder.Build definition, builder.rebars, repeated, builder.rules
            Check prefix & ".repeat", repeated.count = 1 And builder.rebars.count = count
            Near prefix & ".repeat.x", repeated.startX(1), model.Annotations.startX(1)
            Near prefix & ".repeat.y", repeated.startY(1), model.Annotations.startY(1)
        Next value
    Next shape
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "arbitrary.geometry.runtime." & CStr(Err.number) & "." & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunArbitraryAnnotationGeometryTests = mReport & "TOTAL ARBITRARY ANNOTATION GEOMETRY: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: симметричный скруглённый прямоугольник с известными проекциями.
Private Function AngleRoundedPolygon(ByVal halfWidth As Double, ByVal halfHeight As Double, ByVal Radius As Double) As CPolygonSpec
    Dim polygon As CPolygonSpec
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "BL", -halfWidth, -halfHeight, Radius
    polygon.AddVertex "BR", halfWidth, -halfHeight, Radius
    polygon.AddVertex "TR", halfWidth, halfHeight, Radius
    polygon.AddVertex "TL", -halfWidth, halfHeight, Radius
    polygon.Seal
    Set AngleRoundedPolygon = polygon
End Function

Private Function AnnotationFacade(Optional ByVal previewPlacement As Boolean = False) As CSectionDefinitionBuilder
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "AnnotationFixture"
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Boundary", 0#, 0#, 200#): facade.outer "Concrete", path.id
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Row", -50#, 100#, 50#, 100#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.AnnotationGroup = "Top"
    facade.RebarByCount "TopBars", path.id, 2, 10#, options
    If previewPlacement Then
        facade.anchor "A", -100#, -75#: facade.anchor "B", -70#, -35#
        facade.anchor "LengthNote", -60#, -150#: facade.anchor "TextNote", 50#, -50#
    Else
        facade.anchor "A", 0#, 0#: facade.anchor "B", 30#, 40#: facade.anchor "LengthNote", 0#, -100#
        facade.anchor "TextNote", 200#, 0#
    End If
    facade.PathAnchor "East", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0#
    facade.dimension "Horizontal", "A", "B", "dx", "Horizontal"
    facade.dimension "Vertical", "A", "B", "dy", "Vertical"
    facade.dimension "Diagonal", "A", "B", "s"
    If previewPlacement Then facade.VerticalDistance "VerticalExplicit", "v", -100#, 0#, 150#, 1# Else facade.VerticalDistance "VerticalExplicit", "v", -100#, 0#, -50#
    facade.VerticalExtent "Height", "Boundary", "H", -200#
    If previewPlacement Then
        facade.HorizontalExtent "Width", "Boundary", "B", -200#, -1#
        facade.Radius "Radius", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0.75
        facade.diameter "Diameter", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0.25
    Else
        facade.HorizontalExtent "Width", "Boundary", "B", -200#
        facade.Radius "Radius", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0#
        facade.diameter "Diameter", "Boundary", "Boundary", 0#
    End If
    facade.PathLength "Length", "Boundary", "LengthNote"
    facade.text "Note", "TextNote", "Проверка привязки"
    facade.RebarRowLabel "Top", "TopBars", 0#, 1#
    Set AnnotationFacade = facade
End Function

Private Function BuildDefinition(ByVal definition As CSectionDefinition, ByVal builder As CSectionBuilder) As CSectionModel
    Dim mesh As TSectionMeshOptions
    mesh.stepX = 100#: mesh.stepY = 100#: mesh.materialID = 1: mesh.boundarySubdivisions = 2
    Set BuildDefinition = builder.Build(definition, mesh)
End Function

Private Function InvalidAnnotation(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, definition As CSectionDefinition, builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel
    Set facade = AnnotationFacade
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0: facade.dimension "Missing", "Unknown", "B", "s"
        Case 1: facade.dimension "UnknownMode", "A", "B", "s", "Unknown"
        Case 2: facade.Radius "LineRadius", "Row", "Row"
        Case 3: facade.diameter "InvalidParameter", "Boundary", "Boundary", 2#
        Case 4: facade.PathAnchor "MissingSegment", "Boundary", "RemovedArc"
    End Select
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set builder = New CSectionBuilder: Set model = BuildDefinition(definition, builder)
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    InvalidAnnotation = (Err.number = vbObjectError + 5530 Or Err.number = vbObjectError + 5520): Err.Clear
End Function

Private Sub Check(ByVal Name As String, ByVal value As Boolean)
    If value Then mPassed = mPassed + 1 Else mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & Name & vbCrLf
End Sub

Private Sub Near(ByVal Name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    Check Name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000000001 * (1# + Abs(expected))
End Sub

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' Причина ошибки построения геометрии
' ==========================================================================
' Хранит код причины, пояснение и связь с исходными данными.
' Этот объект описывает геометрическую ошибку независимо от Excel и статуса расчёта НДС.

Private mCode As String, mEntity As String, mRelated As String, mReason As String, mSource As String ' Код, основной и связанный объект, причина и источник геометрической ошибки.
Private mDetail1 As Double, mDetail2 As Double ' Два числовых уточнения ошибки; смысл зависит от её кода.

' Заполняет код, причину и связи диагностической записи с исходной геометрией или правилом.
Friend Sub Initialize(ByVal Code As String, ByVal entityID As String, ByVal relatedEntityID As String, _
        ByVal reason As String, Optional ByVal detail1 As Double = 0#, Optional ByVal detail2 As Double = 0#, _
        Optional ByVal SourceReference As String = "")
    If Len(mCode) > 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 5530, "CGeometryDiagnostic", "Диагностика уже опубликована."
    mCode = Code: mEntity = entityID: mRelated = relatedEntityID: mReason = reason
    mDetail1 = detail1: mDetail2 = detail2: mSource = SourceReference
End Sub

' Машинный код причины; назначается напрямую, не извлекается из русского текста.
Public Property Get Code() As String: Code = mCode: End Property
' Возвращает ID геометрического объекта или правила, при обработке которого возникла ошибка.
Public Property Get entityID() As String: entityID = mEntity: End Property
' Возвращает ID связанного сегмента, позиции или стержня, помогающий найти причину ошибки.
Public Property Get relatedEntityID() As String: relatedEntityID = mRelated: End Property
' Возвращает пояснение причины для человека; код ошибки хранится отдельно в Code.
Public Property Get reason() As String: reason = mReason: End Property
' Возвращает первое численное уточнение причины; смысл и единицы зависят от Code.
Public Property Get detail1() As Double: detail1 = mDetail1: End Property
' Возвращает второе численное уточнение причины; смысл и единицы зависят от Code.
Public Property Get detail2() As Double: detail2 = mDetail2: End Property
' Возвращает адрес исходного параметра или текстовую ссылку на место его задания.
Public Property Get SourceReference() As String: SourceReference = mSource: End Property

Option Explicit

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: смещение и ограничение линий, а также понятные причины ошибок размещения арматуры.
Private mPassed As Long, mFailed As Long, mReport As String

Public Function RunRecipeOperationTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, source As CGeometryPath, definition As CSectionDefinition
    Dim edge As TRegionEdge, x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, i As Long, query As CSectionGeometryQuery
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "Operations"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Concrete", -200#, -200#, 400#, 400#): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
    Set path = facade.LinePath("FullFace", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#)
    Set path = facade.offset("Axis", "FullFace", 20#)
    path.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty: Near "offset.full.start.x", x, 0#: Near "offset.normal.y", y, 20#
    Near "offset.full.length", path.Length, 100#
    Set path = facade.ConstrainLine("Extended", "Axis", 1#, 0#, -15#, 1#, 0#, 125#)
    path.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty: Near "constraint.extension.start", x, -15#: Near "constraint.extension.y", y, 20#
    Near "constraint.extension.length", path.Length, 140#
    Near "constraint.source.start", path.SourceStartParameter(1), -0.15
    Near "constraint.source.end", path.SourceEndParameter(1), 1.25
    Check "constraint.source.identity", path.sourcePathID(1) = "FullFace" And path.sourceSegmentID(1) = "FullFace"
    Set path = facade.ConstrainLine("Trimmed", "Axis", 1#, 0#, 10#, 1#, 0#, 80#)
    Near "constraint.trim.length", path.Length, 70#
    Set source = New CGeometryPath: source.Initialize "Corner"
    source.AddLine "Bottom", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#: source.AddLine "Right", 100#, 0#, 100#, 100#: source.Seal
    facade.AddPath source: Set path = facade.offset("Miter", "Corner", 10#)
    path.CopySegment 1, edge: Near "miter.x", edge.x2, 90#: Near "miter.y", edge.y2, 10#
    path.CopySegment 2, edge: Near "miter.continuous.x", edge.x1, 90#: Near "miter.continuous.y", edge.y1, 10#
    Near "miter.length", path.Length, 180#
    Near "miter.source.first.end", path.SourceEndParameter(1), 0.9
    Near "miter.source.second.start", path.SourceStartParameter(2), 0.1
    Set source = New CGeometryPath: source.Initialize "Smooth"
    source.AddLine "Straight", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#
    source.AddArc "Fillet", 100#, 50#, 50#, -GEOM_PI / 2#, GEOM_PI / 2#: source.Seal
    facade.AddPath source: Set path = facade.offset("SmoothOffset", source.id, 10#)
    Near "offset.analytic.length", path.Length, 100# + 20# * GEOM_PI
    path.CopySegment 2, edge: Near "offset.arc.radius", Sqr((edge.x1 - edge.centerX) ^ 2 + (edge.y1 - edge.centerY) ^ 2), 40#
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Circle", 0#, 0#, 100#): Set path = facade.offset("CircleInner", path.id, 20#)
    Near "offset.circle.length", path.Length, 160# * GEOM_PI: Check "offset.circle.closed", path.IsClosed
    Set source = facade.Transform("MovedFace", "FullFace", 500#, -200#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True)
    facade.anchor "CornerAnchor", 100#, 0#: facade.TransformAnchor "MovedAnchor", "CornerAnchor", 500#, -200#, GEOM_PI / 2#, True
    Set definition = facade.Finish: definition.AnchorCoordinates "MovedAnchor", x, y
    Near "transform.anchor.x", x, 500#: Near "transform.anchor.y", y, -100#
    source.AtDistance source.Length, x, y, tx, ty
    Near "transform.path.anchor.x", x, 500#: Near "transform.path.anchor.y", y, -100#
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery
    Set source = New CGeometryPath: source.Initialize "CCW"
    source.AddLine "Bottom", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#: source.AddLine "Right", 100#, 0#, 100#, 100#
    source.AddLine "Top", 100#, 100#, 0#, 100#: source.AddLine "Left", 0#, 100#, 0#, 0#: source.Seal True
    Set path = query.offsetPath("Inset", source, 10#): Near "offset.closed.area", query.RegionFromPath(path).area, 6400#
    Set source = source.reversed: Set path = query.offsetPath("OutsetCW", source, 10#)
    Near "offset.direction.left", query.RegionFromPath(path).area, 14400#
    For i = 0 To 4: Check "operations.invalid." & CStr(i), InvalidOperation(i): Next i
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "operations.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunRecipeOperationTests = mReport & "TOTAL RECIPE OPERATIONS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function InvalidOperation(ByVal scenario As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo Rejected
    Dim query As CSectionGeometryQuery, path As CGeometryPath, result As CGeometryPath, diagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic, expected As String
    Set query = New CSectionGeometryQuery: Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Source"
    Select Case scenario
        Case 0
            expected = "CONSTRAINT_PARALLEL": path.AddLine "Line", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#: path.Seal
            Set result = query.ConstrainLine("Failed", path, 0#, 1#, 10#, 1#, 0#, 90#)
        Case 1
            expected = "CONSTRAINT_DISAPPEARED": path.AddLine "Line", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#: path.Seal
            Set result = query.ConstrainLine("Failed", path, 1#, 0#, 90#, 1#, 0#, 10#)
        Case 2
            expected = "OFFSET_DISAPPEARED": path.AddArc "Arc", 0#, 0#, 10#, 0#, GEOM_PI: path.Seal
            Set result = query.offsetPath("Failed", path, 20#)
        Case 3
            expected = "CONSTRAINT_TARGET": path.AddArc "Arc", 0#, 0#, 10#, 0#, GEOM_PI: path.Seal
            Set result = query.ConstrainLine("Failed", path, 1#, 0#, 0#, 1#, 0#, 10#)
        Case 4
            expected = "OFFSET_JOINT": path.AddLine "Line", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#
            path.AddArc "NonTangent", 100#, 10#, 10#, -GEOM_PI / 2#, -GEOM_PI / 2#: path.Seal
            Set result = query.offsetPath("Failed", path, 1#)
    End Select
    Exit Function
Rejected:
    If Err.number <> vbObjectError + 5401 Then Exit Function
    Set diagnostic = query.LastDiagnostic
    InvalidOperation = (Not diagnostic Is Nothing)
    If InvalidOperation Then InvalidOperation = diagnostic.Code = expected And diagnostic.entityID = "Failed" And Len(diagnostic.relatedEntityID) > 0
    If scenario = 2 And InvalidOperation Then InvalidOperation = diagnostic.detail1 = 10# And diagnostic.detail2 = 20#
    Err.Clear
End Function

Public Function RunRecipeDiagnosticTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, definition As CSectionDefinition, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim rules As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, diagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic, i As Long, mode As Long
    For mode = 0 To 2
        Set facade = DiagnosticFacade: Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
        If mode = 2 Then options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
        facade.source "Bars", "ProgramInputs.Spacing"
        facade.RebarAtStations "Bars", "Row", Array(10#, IIf(mode = 0, 25#, 20#)), 20#, options
        Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor
        If mode = 2 Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
            i = Err.number: Err.Clear
            On Error GoTo Failed
            Set diagnostic = rules.LastDiagnostic
            Check "overlap.reject", i = vbObjectError + 5530 And diagnostic.Code = "BAR_OVERLAP"
            Check "overlap.source", diagnostic.entityID = "Bars" And diagnostic.SourceReference = "ProgramInputs.Spacing"
            Near "overlap.numeric.gap", diagnostic.detail1, -10#
            Check "overlap.error.actual.created", rules.RequestedPositions = 2 And rules.CreatedPositions = 1 And rules.Conflicts = 1
        Else
            Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
            Check "overlap.physical." & CStr(mode), layout.count = 2 And rules.RequestedPositions = 2 And rules.CreatedPositions = 2
            Check "overlap.report." & CStr(mode), rules.BarOverlaps = 1
            Check "overlap.machine." & CStr(mode), rules.DiagnosticAt(1).Code = "BAR_OVERLAP"
            Check "trace.rule." & CStr(mode), InStr(rules.RuleTrace("Bars"), "Created=2") > 0 And InStr(rules.RuleTrace("Bars"), "StationStepMax=") > 0
            Check "trace.owner." & CStr(mode), rules.PositionPhysicalOwner(1) = 1 And rules.PositionPhysicalOwner(2) = 2
            Check "trace.ids." & CStr(mode), rules.PositionRuleID(1) = "Bars" And rules.PositionPathID(1) = "Row" And rules.PositionSourceID(1) = "Bars.1"
        End If
    Next mode
    Set facade = DiagnosticFacade
    facade.RebarAtStations "Contact", "Row", Array(10#, 30#), 20#
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
    Check "contact.allowed", rules.BarOverlaps = 0 And layout.count = 2
    Set facade = DiagnosticFacade
    facade.RebarByCount "Base", "Row", 3, 10#
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Target", 20#, 50#, 80#, 50#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.directionY = 1#: options.SkipMissingProjection = True
    facade.source "Projected", "ProgramInputs.Target"
    facade.RebarProjected "Projected", "Target", "Base", 10#, options
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
    Check "projection.counts", rules.RequestedPositions = 6 And rules.CreatedPositions = 4 And rules.SkippedProjections = 2
    Check "projection.trace", InStr(rules.RuleTrace("Projected"), "Requested=3; Created=1; Merged=0; Skipped=2") > 0
    Check "projection.machine", rules.DiagnosticCount = 2 And rules.DiagnosticAt(1).Code = "PROJECTION_MISSING"
    Check "projection.related", rules.DiagnosticAt(1).relatedEntityID = "Base.1" And rules.DiagnosticAt(2).relatedEntityID = "Base.3"
    Check "projection.source", rules.DiagnosticAt(1).SourceReference = "ProgramInputs.Target"
    Set facade = DiagnosticFacade: Set path = facade.CirclePath("Ring", 0#, 0#, 40#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.EndMode = ClosedUniform
    facade.RebarAtStations "RingBars", path.id, Array(0#, 10#, 20#), 4#, options
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
    Dim stepCount As Long, minStep As Double, maxStep As Double, minChord As Double, maxChord As Double
    rules.RuleStepBounds "RingBars", stepCount, minStep, maxStep, minChord, maxChord
    Check "trace.closed.count", stepCount = 3
    Near "trace.closed.minimum", minStep, 10#
    Near "trace.closed.wrap.maximum", maxStep, 80# * GEOM_PI - 20#
    Near "trace.closed.chord", maxChord, 80# * Sin(0.25)
    Set facade = DiagnosticFacade
    Dim dense() As Double
    ReDim dense(0 To 99)
    For i = 0 To 99: dense(i) = CDbl(i): Next i
    facade.RebarAtStations "Dense", "Row", dense, 20#
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
    Check "diagnostics.bounded.full.counts", rules.CreatedPositions = 100 And rules.BarOverlaps = 1710
    Check "diagnostics.bounded.records", rules.DiagnosticCount = 128 And rules.DiagnosticRecordsOmitted = 1582
    Check "diagnostics.bounded.latest", rules.LastDiagnostic.Code = "BAR_OVERLAP" And rules.LastDiagnostic.entityID = "Dense"
    Set facade = DiagnosticFacade: Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.Coincidence = MergeIdentical
    facade.RebarAtStations "First", "Row", Array(50#), 10#
    facade.RebarAtStations "Second", "Row", Array(50#), 10#, options
    Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
    Check "merge.counts", rules.RequestedPositions = 2 And rules.CreatedPositions = 1 And rules.MergedPositions = 1
    Check "merge.physical.owner", rules.PositionPhysicalOwner(1) = 1 And rules.PositionPhysicalOwner(2) = 1
    Check "merge.trace", InStr(rules.RuleTrace("Second"), "Created=0; Merged=1") > 0
    ' Неподдерживаемый способ распределения вызывает ошибку без произвольной подстановки.
    Set facade = DiagnosticFacade: Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.DistributionScope = 2
    On Error Resume Next
    facade.RebarByCount "Unsupported", "Row", 3, 10#, options
    i = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Check "scope.invalid", i = vbObjectError + 5530
    On Error Resume Next
    Set layout = rules.Build(Nothing, Nothing)
    i = Err.number: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Check "diagnostics.failed.reuse", i = vbObjectError + 5530 And rules.LastDiagnostic.Code = "RULE_INVALID"
    Check "diagnostics.failed.reuse.counts", rules.RequestedPositions = 0 And rules.CreatedPositions = 0 And rules.MergedPositions = 0 And rules.SkippedProjections = 0
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "diagnostics.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunRecipeDiagnosticTests = mReport & "TOTAL RECIPE DIAGNOSTICS: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Private Function DiagnosticFacade() As CSectionDefinitionBuilder
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "Diagnostics"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Concrete", -100#, -100#, 300#, 300#): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Row", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#)
    Set DiagnosticFacade = facade
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: поиск по координатам не изменяет линии; выделение участка через Chain сохраняет
' свои правила.
Public Function RunResolveAnchorTests() As String
    mPassed = 0: mFailed = 0: mReport = ""
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, polygon As CPolygonSpec
    Dim rightID As String, t As Double, right As CGeometryPath, x As Double, y As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "ResolveAnchor"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Rect", 0#, 0#, 400#, 600#)
    path.ResolveAnchor 400#, 300#, rightID, t
    Near "rectangle.right.parameter", t, 0.5
    Set right = facade.chain("Right", path.id, rightID, 1#, rightID, 0#, False)
    Near "rectangle.right.length", right.Length, 600#
    right.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty: Near "rectangle.right.start.x", x, 400#: Near "rectangle.right.start.y", y, 600#
    right.AtDistance right.Length, x, y, tx, ty: Near "rectangle.right.end.y", y, 0#: Check "rectangle.right.direction", ty < 0#
    CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.AdjacentRectangles("Adjacent", Array(Array(0#, 0#, 400#, 200#), Array(0#, 200#, 200#, 400#)))
    CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set polygon = New CPolygonSpec
    polygon.AddVertex "BL", 0#, 0#, 30#: polygon.AddVertex "BR", 400#, 0#, 40#
    polygon.AddVertex "TR", 400#, 600#, 50#: polygon.AddVertex "TL", 0#, 600#, 60#: polygon.Seal
    Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Rounded", polygon): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.OffsetRoundedPolygon("RoundedOffset", polygon, 10#): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Circle", 25#, -15#, 100#): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.ArcPath("ArcCCW", 15#, 30#, 80#, 0.9 * GEOM_PI, 0.8 * GEOM_PI): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    ExpectAnchorError path, 15# + 80#, 30#, "ANCHOR_NOT_ON_PATH"
    Set path = facade.ArcPath("ArcCW", -10#, 40#, 80#, -0.9 * GEOM_PI, -0.8 * GEOM_PI): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Line", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    ' Преобразования проверяются и для прямых, и для скруглений; отражение меняет знак дуги.
    Set path = facade.Transform("MovedRect", "Rect", 1000#, -700#, GEOM_PI / 3#, True): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.Transform("MovedRounded", "Rounded", -900#, 700#, GEOM_PI / 3#, True): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.Transform("MovedCircle", "Circle", 900#, -1700#, -GEOM_PI / 4#, True): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    Set path = facade.Transform("MovedArc", "ArcCW", -900#, -700#, GEOM_PI / 4#): CheckResolvedPath facade, path
    ' Реальный общий допуск границы допускает малую поперечную погрешность, но не ближайшую произвольную точку.
    Set path = facade.LinePath("Tolerance", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#)
    path.ResolveAnchor 50#, GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE / 2#, rightID, t: Near "tolerance.accepted", t, 0.5
    ExpectAnchorError path, 50#, GEOM_BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE * 2#, "ANCHOR_NOT_ON_PATH"
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Retraced"
    path.AddLine "Out", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#: path.AddLine "Back", 100#, 0#, 0#, 0#: path.Seal
    ExpectAnchorError path, 50#, 0#, "ANCHOR_AMBIGUOUS"
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Unsealed": path.AddLine "Only", 0#, 0#, 100#, 0#
    ExpectAnchorError path, 50#, 0#, "PATH_INVALID"
    TestPositionOrderOwner
    GoTo Finished
Failed:
    Check "anchor.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunResolveAnchorTests = mReport & "TOTAL RESOLVE ANCHOR: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

' Проверяет сегменты, оба направления обхода Chain, длины, концы и соответствие участкам
' исходных линий.
Private Sub CheckResolvedPath(ByVal facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, ByVal path As CGeometryPath)
    Dim i As Long, edge As TRegionEdge, segment As String, parameter As Double, x As Double, y As Double
    Dim chain As CGeometryPath, station As Double, tx As Double, ty As Double, a As Double, b As Double
    Dim expectedX As Double, expectedY As Double, label As String, reverse As Long
    station = 0#
    For i = 1 To path.segmentCount
        label = path.id & "." & CStr(i): path.CopySegment i, edge
        modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint edge, 0.25, x, y
        path.ResolveAnchor x, y, segment, parameter
        Check label & ".id", segment = path.segmentID(i): Near label & ".parameter", parameter, 0.25
        For reverse = 0 To 1
            a = 0.25: b = 0.75: If reverse = 1 Then a = 0.75: b = 0.25
            Set chain = facade.chain(label & ".Chain" & CStr(reverse), path.id, segment, a, segment, b, reverse = 0)
            Check label & ".chain.id", chain.segmentCount = 1 And chain.segmentID(1) = segment
            Check label & ".source.id", chain.sourcePathID(1) = path.sourcePathID(i) And chain.sourceSegmentID(1) = path.sourceSegmentID(i)
            Near label & ".source.start", chain.SourceStartParameter(1), path.SourceStartParameter(i) + a * (path.SourceEndParameter(i) - path.SourceStartParameter(i))
            Near label & ".source.end", chain.SourceEndParameter(1), path.SourceStartParameter(i) + b * (path.SourceEndParameter(i) - path.SourceStartParameter(i))
            Near label & ".length", chain.Length, modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(edge) / 2#
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint edge, a, expectedX, expectedY: chain.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
            Near label & ".start.x", x, expectedX: Near label & ".start.y", y, expectedY
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint edge, b, expectedX, expectedY: chain.AtDistance chain.Length, x, y, tx, ty
            Near label & ".end.x", x, expectedX: Near label & ".end.y", y, expectedY
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeTangent edge, b, expectedX, expectedY
            If reverse = 1 Then expectedX = -expectedX: expectedY = -expectedY
            Check label & ".direction", tx * expectedX + ty * expectedY > 0#
        Next reverse
        If i > 1 Or path.IsClosed And path.segmentCount > 1 Then
            ExpectAnchorError path, edge.x1, edge.y1, "ANCHOR_AMBIGUOUS"
        Else
            path.ResolveAnchor edge.x1, edge.y1, segment, parameter: Near label & ".start.parameter", parameter, 0#
        End If
        If i = path.segmentCount And Not path.IsClosed Then
            path.ResolveAnchor edge.x2, edge.y2, segment, parameter: Near label & ".end.parameter", parameter, 1#
        End If
        station = station + modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(edge)
    Next i
    Near path.id & ".unchanged.length", path.Length, station
    ExpectAnchorError path, 100000#, -100000#, "ANCHOR_NOT_ON_PATH"
    If path.segmentCount > 1 Then
        Dim first As TRegionEdge, last As TRegionEdge, startID As String, endID As String, startT As Double, endT As Double
        path.CopySegment 1, first: path.CopySegment 2, last
        modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint first, 0.75, x, y: path.ResolveAnchor x, y, startID, startT
        modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint last, 0.25, x, y: path.ResolveAnchor x, y, endID, endT
        Set chain = facade.chain(path.id & ".JointChain", path.id, startID, startT, endID, endT)
        Check path.id & ".joint.chain.ids", chain.segmentCount = 2 And chain.segmentID(1) = startID And chain.segmentID(2) = endID
        Near path.id & ".joint.chain.length", chain.Length, (modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(first) + modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(last)) / 4#
        Check path.id & ".joint.chain.origin", chain.sourceSegmentID(1) = path.sourceSegmentID(1) And chain.sourceSegmentID(2) = path.sourceSegmentID(2)
        modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint first, 0.75, expectedX, expectedY: chain.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
        Near path.id & ".joint.start.x", x, expectedX: Near path.id & ".joint.start.y", y, expectedY
        modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint last, 0.25, expectedX, expectedY: chain.AtDistance chain.Length, x, y, tx, ty
        Near path.id & ".joint.end.x", x, expectedX: Near path.id & ".joint.end.y", y, expectedY
        If path.IsClosed Then
            path.CopySegment path.segmentCount, last
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint last, 0.75, x, y: path.ResolveAnchor x, y, startID, startT
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint first, 0.25, x, y: path.ResolveAnchor x, y, endID, endT
            Set chain = facade.chain(path.id & ".WrapChain", path.id, startID, startT, endID, endT)
            Check path.id & ".wrap.ids", chain.segmentCount = 2 And chain.segmentID(1) = startID And chain.segmentID(2) = endID
            Near path.id & ".wrap.length", chain.Length, (modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(first) + modGeometryPrimitives.EdgeLength(last)) / 4#
            Check path.id & ".wrap.origin", chain.sourceSegmentID(1) = path.sourceSegmentID(path.segmentCount) And chain.sourceSegmentID(2) = path.sourceSegmentID(1)
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint last, 0.75, expectedX, expectedY: chain.AtDistance 0#, x, y, tx, ty
            Near path.id & ".wrap.start.x", x, expectedX: Near path.id & ".wrap.start.y", y, expectedY
            modGeometryPrimitives.EdgePoint first, 0.25, expectedX, expectedY: chain.AtDistance chain.Length, x, y, tx, ty
            Near path.id & ".wrap.end.x", x, expectedX: Near path.id & ".wrap.end.y", y, expectedY
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' Ошибка оставляет переданные выходные значения неизменными и содержит координаты точки.
Private Sub ExpectAnchorError(ByVal path As CGeometryPath, ByVal x As Double, ByVal y As Double, ByVal Code As String)
    Dim segment As String, parameter As Double, number As Long, reason As String, diagnostic As CGeometryDiagnostic
    segment = "unchanged": parameter = -1#
    On Error Resume Next
    path.ResolveAnchor x, y, segment, parameter: number = Err.number: reason = Err.description: Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set diagnostic = path.LastDiagnostic
    Check path.id & ".error.number", number = vbObjectError + 5520 And InStr(reason, path.id) > 0
    Check path.id & ".error.outputs", segment = "unchanged" And parameter = -1#
    Check path.id & ".error.diagnostic", Not diagnostic Is Nothing
    If Not diagnostic Is Nothing Then
        Check path.id & ".error.code", diagnostic.Code = Code And diagnostic.entityID = path.id
        If Code <> "PATH_INVALID" Then
            Near path.id & ".error.x", diagnostic.detail1, x: Near path.id & ".error.y", diagnostic.detail2, y
        End If
        If Code = "ANCHOR_AMBIGUOUS" Then Check path.id & ".error.segments", InStr(diagnostic.relatedEntityID, ", ") > 0
    End If
End Sub

' Контрпример: при совпадении стержней KeepPublishedOwner сохраняет диаметр того, который
' добавлен первым.
Private Sub TestPositionOrderOwner()
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, options As CRebarRuleOptions, path As CGeometryPath
    Dim definition As CSectionDefinition, rules As CRebarRuleExecutor, layout As CRebarLayout, mode As Long, owner As Long
    For mode = AlongPath To FromPathMiddle
        Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "PublicationOwner"
        Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Concrete", -50#, -50#, 150#, 100#): facade.outer "Outer", path.id
        Set path = facade.LinePath("Row", 0#, 0#, 30#, 0#)
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
        options.PositionOrder = mode: options.Publication = PublishPerSourcePosition: options.Coincidence = KeepPublishedOwner
        facade.RebarByCount "Main", path.id, 3, 10#, options
        Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
        options.Publication = PublishPerSourcePosition: options.Coincidence = KeepPublishedOwner: options.TangentOffset = 15#
        facade.RebarDependent "Extra", "Main", 20#, options
        Set definition = facade.Finish: Set rules = New CRebarRuleExecutor: Set layout = FixtureAnnotatedLayout(definition, rules)
        owner = layout.FindBarAt(15#, 0#): Check "position.order.owner.exists", owner > 0
        If owner > 0 Then
            If mode = AlongPath Then Near "position.order.along.diameter", layout.diameter(owner), 20# Else Near "position.order.middle.diameter", layout.diameter(owner), 10#
        End If
    Next mode
End Sub

Private Sub Check(ByVal Name As String, ByVal value As Boolean)
    If value Then mPassed = mPassed + 1 Else mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & Name & vbCrLf
End Sub

Private Sub Near(ByVal Name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    Check Name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000000001 * (1# + Abs(expected))
End Sub

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: задаёт все данные для коротких примеров API без нового рабочего типа сечения.
Public Function AdvancedGuideDefinition(ByVal useMaxStep As Boolean) As CSectionDefinition
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim a As Double, b As Double, c As Double
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "GuideFragments"
    Set path = facade.RectanglePath("Concrete", -300#, -400#, 1000#, 800#)
    facade.outer "Outer", "Concrete"
    Set path = facade.CirclePath("Hole", 0#, -250#, 50#)
    facade.opening "Opening", "Hole", "Outer"
    ' Боковая линия состоит из дуги, наклонного отрезка, дуги вершины, наклонного отрезка и
    ' дуги.
    a = 100# / Sqr(2#): b = 300# + 50# / Sqr(2#): c = 50# / Sqr(2#)
    Set path = New CGeometryPath: path.Initialize "Nose"
    path.AddArc "HeelLow", 0#, 0#, 100#, -GEOM_PI / 2#, GEOM_PI / 4#
    path.AddLine "InclinedLow", a, -a, b, -c
    path.AddArc "NoseArc", 300#, 0#, 50#, -GEOM_PI / 4#, GEOM_PI / 2#
    path.AddLine "InclinedHigh", b, c, a, a
    path.AddArc "HeelHigh", 0#, 0#, 100#, GEOM_PI / 4#, GEOM_PI / 4#
    path.Seal: facade.AddPath path
    Set path = facade.chain("Side", "Nose", "HeelLow", 0#, "HeelHigh", 1#)
    facade.RebarAtStations "SideBars", "Side", Array(50#, 200#, 400#, 600#), 10#
    ' Одна группа объединяет две независимые линии. Количество и шаг задаются для каждой линии
    ' отдельно.
    Set path = facade.LinePath("RowA", -150#, 250#, 50#, 250#)
    Set path = facade.LinePath("RowB", 250#, 200#, 500#, 200#)
    facade.PathGroup "Independent", Array("RowA", "RowB")
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
    options.DistributionScope = PerPath: options.StartSetback = 20#: options.EndSetback = 30#
    options.AnnotationGroup = "RowsLabel"
    options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    If useMaxStep Then
        facade.RebarByMaxStep "Rows", "Independent", 100#, 10#, options
    Else
        facade.RebarByCount "Rows", "Independent", 4, 10#, options
    End If
    ' Внутренний ряд смещается от границы отверстия в бетон без ручного задания координат
    ' стержней.
    Set path = facade.offset("HoleAxis", "Hole", -30#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.EndMode = ClosedUniform
    options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    facade.RebarByCount "Inner", "HoleAxis", 6, 8#, options
    Set path = facade.LinePath("BasePath", -150#, -350#, 150#, -350#)
    facade.RebarByCount "Base", "BasePath", 4, 10#
    ' Два из четырёх лучей попадают на конечную круговую ось; пропуски явные.
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.EndMode = ClosedUniform
    options.directionY = 1#: options.SkipMissingProjection = True
    options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    facade.RebarProjected "Projected", "HoleAxis", "Base", 6#, options
    ' Дополнительные стержни связываются с каждой второй исходной позицией и смещаются по
    ' нормали.
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions: options.NormalOffset = 10#: options.everySecond = True
    options.SourceSuffix = "_Extra": facade.RebarDependent "Extra", "Base", 10#, options
    facade.VerticalExtent "Height", "Concrete", "H", 740#
    facade.RebarRowLabel "RowsLabel", "Rows", 0#, 1#
    Set AdvancedGuideDefinition = facade.Finish
End Function

    region.GetSegment 1, x, y, x2, y2, cx, cy, sweep, loopID

    Check "frame.runtime: " & CStr(Err.number) & "; " & Err.description, False
Finished:
    RunRoundedFrameExampleTests = mReport & "TOTAL ROUNDED FRAME EXAMPLE: passed=" & CStr(mPassed) & "; failed=" & CStr(mFailed) & vbCrLf
End Function

Public Function DumpRoundedFrameExamplePreview(ByVal outputDirectory As String) As String
    Dim builder As CSectionBuilder, model As CSectionModel, definition As CSectionDefinition, mesh As TSectionMeshOptions
    Set definition = RoundedFrameDefinition: Set builder = New CSectionBuilder
    mesh.stepX = 80#: mesh.stepY = 80#: mesh.materialID = 1: mesh.boundarySubdivisions = 4
    Set model = builder.Build(definition, mesh)
    DumpRoundedFrameExamplePreview = modTestShapeArchitecture.PreparedPreviewSnapshot("RoundedFrame.E09", model, outputDirectory)
End Function

' ДЛЯ ТЕСТОВ: все входы уже в мм; 24 наружных и 16 внутренних стержней.
Public Function RoundedFrameDefinition() As CSectionDefinition
    Dim polygonSpec As CPolygonSpec, polygonPoint As Variant
    Dim facade As CSectionDefinitionBuilder, path As CGeometryPath, options As CRebarRuleOptions
    Dim outerVertices As Variant, openingVertices As Variant, outerCorners As Variant, innerCorners As Variant
    Set facade = New CSectionDefinitionBuilder: facade.Initialize "RoundedFrameExample"
    outerVertices = Array(Array(-600#, -400#), Array(600#, -400#), Array(600#, 400#), Array(-600#, 400#))
    openingVertices = Array(Array(-250#, -170#), Array(350#, -170#), Array(350#, 130#), Array(-250#, 130#))
    outerCorners = Array("Outer.BL", "Outer.BR", "Outer.TR", "Outer.TL")
    innerCorners = Array("Inner.BL", "Inner.BR", "Inner.TR", "Inner.TL")
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 0)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 1)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 2)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 3)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Outer", polygonSpec)
    facade.outer "Concrete", path.id
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 0)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 1)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 2)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 3)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = facade.RoundedPolygon("Opening", polygonSpec)
    facade.opening "Void", path.id, "Concrete"
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 0)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 1)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 2)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonPoint = outerVertices(LBound(outerVertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(outerCorners(LBound(outerCorners) + 3)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 80#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = facade.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Outer.Axis", polygonSpec, 60#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
    options.EndMode = ClosedUniform: options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    options.AnnotationGroup = "OuterBars": options.SourcePrefix = "Outer."
    facade.RebarByCount "OuterBars", path.id, 24, 20#, options
    Set polygonSpec = New CPolygonSpec
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 0)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 0)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 1)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 1)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 2)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 2)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonPoint = openingVertices(LBound(openingVertices) + 3)
    polygonSpec.AddVertex CStr(innerCorners(LBound(innerCorners) + 3)), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint))), CDbl(polygonPoint(LBound(polygonPoint) + 1)), 40#
    polygonSpec.Seal
    Set path = facade.OffsetRoundedPolygon("Inner.Axis", polygonSpec, -45#)
    Set options = New CRebarRuleOptions
    options.EndMode = ClosedUniform: options.PlacementCheck = CheckFullDisk: options.OverlapPolicy = RejectOverlap
    options.AnnotationGroup = "InnerBars": options.SourcePrefix = "Inner."
    facade.RebarByCount "InnerBars", path.id, 16, 16#, options
    facade.VerticalExtent "Height", "Outer", "H", -600#, -1#
    facade.HorizontalExtent "Width", "Outer", "B", -400#, -1#
    facade.VerticalExtent "OpeningHeight", "Opening", "Ho", 350#, 1#
    facade.HorizontalExtent "OpeningWidth", "Opening", "Bo", 130#, 1#
    facade.RebarLabel "OuterBars", "Outer.Axis", 0#, 1#
    facade.RebarLabel "InnerBars", "Inner.Axis", 0#, -1#
    Set RoundedFrameDefinition = facade.Finish
End Function

Private Sub Check(ByVal Name As String, ByVal value As Boolean)
    If value Then mPassed = mPassed + 1 Else mFailed = mFailed + 1: mReport = mReport & "FAIL: " & Name & vbCrLf
End Sub

Private Sub Near(ByVal Name As String, ByVal actual As Double, ByVal expected As Double)
    Check Name & "; actual=" & CStr(actual) & "; expected=" & CStr(expected), Abs(actual - expected) <= 0.000000001 * (1# + Abs(expected))
End Sub
